card.desc:
## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

---

# AWAKENING QUESTS

## JIN

**Stage 1 — Knockouts**

- Knock out 150 NPCs.

**Stage 2 — Counters**

- Perform 200 counters.

> → A counter requires you to perfect block an attack and then hit the same attacker within 2 seconds.

**Stage 3 — Meditation**

- Sit for 5 minutes straight on the Rooftop or in the Gardening area during nighttime.

> → You may sit on a seat or use the Sit emote.
> \-> Moving more than 2 studs, taking damage, or entering combat fails the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9ff07637fe57c59c301/previews/6ae4da0007637fe57c59c477/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## BOXING

**Stage 1 — M1s**

- Land 1,500 M1s against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Perfect Blocks**

- Perform 250 perfect blocks.

**Stage 3 — Shadowbox**

- Hit a punching bag in the Dojo Room nonstop for **3** minutes during nighttime.

> → No other players may be inside the Dojo Room.
> \-> Stopping for more than 2.5 seconds resets the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9a47d39f3e7f9539fd4/previews/6ae4d9a47d39f3e7f953a041/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## KARATE

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 400 full M1 combos on a punching bag.

**Stage 2 — Taimans**

- Win 5 taimans.

**Stage 3 — Rain Kata**

- Complete 60 full M1 combos outdoors while it is raining or snowing.

> → No roof or other object may be above you within 60 studs.
> \-> Combos against punching bags or fair opponents both count.
> \-> Progress is saved like a normal counter.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9b590587811402b95db/previews/6ae4d9b690587811402b9621/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## TAIJUTSU

**Stage 1 — Punching Bag Hits**

- Land 2,000 hits on punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Sprinting**

- Sprint 60,000 studs on foot.

> → Must be completed on foot.
> \-> Sprinting while seated, riding a skateboard, or airborne does not count.

**Stage 3 — Gates**

- Land 600 hits on a punching bag in the Dojo Room.

> → Can be completed at any time of day.
> \-> Stopping for more than 5 seconds resets the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d98127ed740a6072da1e/previews/6ae4d98227ed740a6072dc32/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## LETHWEI

**Stage 1 — Guardbreaks**

- Perform 300 guardbreaks.

**Stage 2 — Low-HP Victories**

- Win 15 fights while at low HP.

> → You must knock out your opponent while your HP is at 25% or lower.

**Stage 3 — Blood Oath**

- Defeat a Street Crew leader without blocking at any point during the fight.
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4da188c463b1b586225ee/previews/6ae4da198c463b1b58622694/download/image.webp)

---

## HAKARI

**Stage 1 — Momentum Rush**

- Trigger Momentum Rush 200 times.

> → Momentum Rush requires 4 clean M1s in a row.
> \-> You must have landed a fair hit within the last 3 seconds.

**Stage 2 — Critical Hits**

- Land 200 critical hits (M2).

**Stage 3 — Undefeated**

- Get 5 knockouts in a row.

> → The streak resets if you are knocked down or hit by a critical hit.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9df85fbadbb1d637dc3/previews/6ae4d9e085fbadbb1d637eb5/download/image.webp)

> ‌

**Stage 1 — NPC Critical Hits**

- Land your critical hit (M2) on NPCs 150 times.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Ring**

- Win 3 taimans in a row.

> → Losing a taiman resets the streak.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9ec886fbefd8a98cb77/previews/6ae4d9ec886fbefd8a98cbf0/download/image.webp)

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

---

# AWAKENING QUESTS

## JIN

**Stage 1 — Knockouts**

- Knock out 150 NPCs.

**Stage 2 — Counters**

- Perform 200 counters.

> → A counter requires you to perfect block an attack and then hit the same attacker within 2 seconds.

**Stage 3 — Meditation**

- Sit for 5 minutes straight on the Rooftop or in the Gardening area during nighttime.

> → You may sit on a seat or use the Sit emote.
> \-> Moving more than 2 studs, taking damage, or entering combat fails the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9ff07637fe57c59c301/previews/6ae4da0007637fe57c59c477/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## BOXING

**Stage 1 — M1s**

- Land 1,500 M1s against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Perfect Blocks**

- Perform 250 perfect blocks.

**Stage 3 — Shadowbox**

- Hit a punching bag in the Dojo Room nonstop for **3** minutes during nighttime.

> → No other players may be inside the Dojo Room.
> \-> Stopping for more than 2.5 seconds resets the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9a47d39f3e7f9539fd4/previews/6ae4d9a47d39f3e7f953a041/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## KARATE

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 400 full M1 combos on a punching bag.

**Stage 2 — Taimans**

- Win 5 taimans.

**Stage 3 — Rain Kata**

- Complete 60 full M1 combos outdoors while it is raining or snowing.

> → No roof or other object may be above you within 60 studs.
> \-> Combos against punching bags or fair opponents both count.
> \-> Progress is saved like a normal counter.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9b590587811402b95db/previews/6ae4d9b690587811402b9621/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## TAIJUTSU

**Stage 1 — Punching Bag Hits**

- Land 2,000 hits on punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Sprinting**

- Sprint 60,000 studs on foot.

> → Must be completed on foot.
> \-> Sprinting while seated, riding a skateboard, or airborne does not count.

**Stage 3 — Gates**

- Land 600 hits on a punching bag in the Dojo Room.

> → Can be completed at any time of day.
> \-> Stopping for more than 5 seconds resets the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d98127ed740a6072da1e/previews/6ae4d98227ed740a6072dc32/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## LETHWEI

**Stage 1 — Guardbreaks**

- Perform 300 guardbreaks.

**Stage 2 — Low-HP Victories**

- Win 15 fights while at low HP.

> → You must knock out your opponent while your HP is at 25% or lower.

**Stage 3 — Blood Oath**

- Defeat a Street Crew leader without blocking at any point during the fight.

card.desc:
## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

## Candy Shop

Candy can be acquired by doing numerous mini-events around the map that will be listed below!

‌

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae66b0e633240a0746ed2ae/previews/6ae66b0f633240a0746ed3d3/download/image.webp)

---

## Trick or Treating

Run around the map and walk up to different houses in order to active the prompt!

3 options:

Toilet Paper 3x - Rewards 24+ candy
Trick or Treat - Rewards 5-12+ candy
Jumpscare - Rewards 2-4+ candy
• _At 12:00 AM a 2x candy event starts and ends at 0:44_

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3eeeaef2ed4045814865e/previews/6ad3eeebef2ed404581486d6/download/image.webp)

**Toilet Paper**

![ezgif-15701b61cd6ee51d.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3fda2f4781988b9c556f6/previews/6ad3fdb9f4781988b9c56dda/download/ezgif-15701b61cd6ee51d.gif)

**Trick or Treat**

![ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4072cd15d8a92d0b8efd8/previews/6ad40741d15d8a92d0b90272/download/ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif)

**Jumpscare**

![Jumpscare.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ada33724097a5f8e0bfb9d4/previews/6ada337c4097a5f8e0bfc591/download/Jumpscare.gif)

‌

---

**DARUMA**

Daruma is the big statue outside the school. Once midnight arrives and you speak to it, it’ll make you play a game of red light, green light. At the top of the screen you’ll notice big text saying “Da Ru Ma.” You can walk while the text isn’t finished, but once he finishes saying “Daruma,” he’ll look back and teleport anyone who is moving back to the start. You get 2 chances.

![expomrt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad413a652a2eba459ca6f95/download/expomrt.gif)

**SKELETON**

At midnight in the biology club, when you press on the skeleton, it’ll begin to shake and drop all of its parts. Pick them all up and put them back one by one to win.

![skeelton.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f3f5dad82a0f81bf5ab5/previews/6ad3f41ddad82a0f81bf872a/download/skeelton.gif)

**BACKROOMS**

On the left stairs of the school, find the sign that says “No Running.” Once you count each stair by pressing the button at midnight, you’ll be teleported to a maze with a monster. Start searching for an elevator, and listen for the character saying “An elevator, here?” in case you miss it. Once you press on the elevator, it’ll take up to 10 seconds for the doors to open. Step in to win.

![backrooms.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f46d27afa407d114559c/previews/6ad3f48e27afa407d1147232/download/backrooms.gif)

**MIRROR WORLD**

On the right side of the stairs, you’ll find a mirror as you climb. Interact with it at midnight and you’ll go to a different place where you have to click on the mirror that isn’t copying you. Look for things like twitching, moving differently, acting strangely, or even missing something. Once you find the right one, you’ll win.

![mirror.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f549491c1a924aa36d1f/download/mirror.gif)

**BATHROOM KNOCKS**

In the girls’ bathroom on the second floor, head to the first toilet and interact with it at midnight to start a minigame. You’ll have to find a girl 3 times among the 3 bathroom doors to win. Listen to the knocks and her laugh, and guess correctly to win.

![toilet.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4eec66d70f58473ce6d/previews/6ad3f526c66d70f5847404bf/download/toilet.gif)

**PIANO**

At midnight, the piano in the third-floor music room will summon a girl when you interact with it. She’ll make you press some notes in a pattern. Do it correctly and you’ll win.

![paino.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad41406a5da975e1b0200fe/previews/6ad41431a5da975e1b0239eb/download/paino.gif)

**PHOTO**

On the third floor, inside class 3-A, head to the camera and interact with it at midnight. The class will go dark and a girl will be around. Quickly look around and take a picture by clicking the screen before the time runs out. Do it 3 times and she’ll take a picture with you, winning the game.

![wonder.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4b2bc64e7316077f792/previews/6ad3f4cdbc64e7316078111d/download/wonder.gif)

**FINAL**

Once you complete ALL seven wonders, head to class 3-C near the board. You’ll then take a picture with all of the wonders together, meaning you’ve won!

![exportt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4143e4f522f3f5a468ad7/download/exportt.gif)

## Trick or Treating

Run around the map and walk up to different houses in order to active the prompt!

3 options:

Toilet Paper 3x - Rewards 24+ candy
Trick or Treat - Rewards 5-12+ candy
Jumpscare - Rewards 2-4+ candy
• _At 12:00 AM a 2x candy event starts and ends at 0:44_

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3eeeaef2ed4045814865e/previews/6ad3eeebef2ed404581486d6/download/image.webp)

**Toilet Paper**

![ezgif-15701b61cd6ee51d.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3fda2f4781988b9c556f6/previews/6ad3fdb9f4781988b9c56dda/download/ezgif-15701b61cd6ee51d.gif)

**Trick or Treat**

![ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4072cd15d8a92d0b8efd8/previews/6ad40741d15d8a92d0b90272/download/ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif)

**Jumpscare**

![Jumpscare.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ada33724097a5f8e0bfb9d4/previews/6ada337c4097a5f8e0bfc591/download/Jumpscare.gif)

‌

---

**DARUMA**

Daruma is the big statue outside the school. Once midnight arrives and you speak to it, it’ll make you play a game of red light, green light. At the top of the screen you’ll notice big text saying “Da Ru Ma.” You can walk while the text isn’t finished, but once he finishes saying “Daruma,” he’ll look back and teleport anyone who is moving back to the start. You get 2 chances.

![expomrt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad413a652a2eba459ca6f95/download/expomrt.gif)

**SKELETON**

At midnight in the biology club, when you press on the skeleton, it’ll begin to shake and drop all of its parts. Pick them all up and put them back one by one to win.

![skeelton.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f3f5dad82a0f81bf5ab5/previews/6ad3f41ddad82a0f81bf872a/download/skeelton.gif)

**BACKROOMS**

On the left stairs of the school, find the sign that says “No Running.” Once you count each stair by pressing the button at midnight, you’ll be teleported to a maze with a monster. Start searching for an elevator, and listen for the character saying “An elevator, here?” in case you miss it. Once you press on the elevator, it’ll take up to 10 seconds for the doors to open. Step in to win.

![backrooms.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f46d27afa407d114559c/previews/6ad3f48e27afa407d1147232/download/backrooms.gif)

**MIRROR WORLD**

On the right side of the stairs, you’ll find a mirror as you climb. Interact with it at midnight and you’ll go to a different place where you have to click on the mirror that isn’t copying you. Look for things like twitching, moving differently, acting strangely, or even missing something. Once you find the right one, you’ll win.

![mirror.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f549491c1a924aa36d1f/download/mirror.gif)

**BATHROOM KNOCKS**

In the girls’ bathroom on the second floor, head to the first toilet and interact with it at midnight to start a minigame. You’ll have to find a girl 3 times among the 3 bathroom doors to win. Listen to the knocks and her laugh, and guess correctly to win.

![toilet.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4eec66d70f58473ce6d/previews/6ad3f526c66d70f5847404bf/download/toilet.gif)

**PIANO**

At midnight, the piano in the third-floor music room will summon a girl when you interact with it. She’ll make you press some notes in a pattern. Do it correctly and you’ll win.

![paino.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad41406a5da975e1b0200fe/previews/6ad41431a5da975e1b0239eb/download/paino.gif)

**PHOTO**

On the third floor, inside class 3-A, head to the camera and interact with it at midnight. The class will go dark and a girl will be around. Quickly look around and take a picture by clicking the screen before the time runs out. Do it 3 times and she’ll take a picture with you, winning the game.

![wonder.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4b2bc64e7316077f792/previews/6ad3f4cdbc64e7316078111d/download/wonder.gif)

**FINAL**

Once you complete ALL seven wonders, head to class 3-C near the board. You’ll then take a picture with all of the wonders together, meaning you’ve won!

![exportt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4143e4f522f3f5a468ad7/download/exportt.gif)

**Trick or Treat**

![ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4072cd15d8a92d0b8efd8/previews/6ad40741d15d8a92d0b90272/download/ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif)

**Jumpscare**

![Jumpscare.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ada33724097a5f8e0bfb9d4/previews/6ada337c4097a5f8e0bfc591/download/Jumpscare.gif)

‌

---

**DARUMA**

Daruma is the big statue outside the school. Once midnight arrives and you speak to it, it’ll make you play a game of red light, green light. At the top of the screen you’ll notice big text saying “Da Ru Ma.” You can walk while the text isn’t finished, but once he finishes saying “Daruma,” he’ll look back and teleport anyone who is moving back to the start. You get 2 chances.

![expomrt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad413a652a2eba459ca6f95/download/expomrt.gif)

**SKELETON**

At midnight in the biology club, when you press on the skeleton, it’ll begin to shake and drop all of its parts. Pick them all up and put them back one by one to win.

![skeelton.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f3f5dad82a0f81bf5ab5/previews/6ad3f41ddad82a0f81bf872a/download/skeelton.gif)

**BACKROOMS**

On the left stairs of the school, find the sign that says “No Running.” Once you count each stair by pressing the button at midnight, you’ll be teleported to a maze with a monster. Start searching for an elevator, and listen for the character saying “An elevator, here?” in case you miss it. Once you press on the elevator, it’ll take up to 10 seconds for the doors to open. Step in to win.

![backrooms.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f46d27afa407d114559c/previews/6ad3f48e27afa407d1147232/download/backrooms.gif)

**MIRROR WORLD**

On the right side of the stairs, you’ll find a mirror as you climb. Interact with it at midnight and you’ll go to a different place where you have to click on the mirror that isn’t copying you. Look for things like twitching, moving differently, acting strangely, or even missing something. Once you find the right one, you’ll win.

![mirror.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f549491c1a924aa36d1f/download/mirror.gif)

**BATHROOM KNOCKS**

In the girls’ bathroom on the second floor, head to the first toilet and interact with it at midnight to start a minigame. You’ll have to find a girl 3 times among the 3 bathroom doors to win. Listen to the knocks and her laugh, and guess correctly to win.

![toilet.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4eec66d70f58473ce6d/previews/6ad3f526c66d70f5847404bf/download/toilet.gif)

**PIANO**

At midnight, the piano in the third-floor music room will summon a girl when you interact with it. She’ll make you press some notes in a pattern. Do it correctly and you’ll win.

![paino.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad41406a5da975e1b0200fe/previews/6ad41431a5da975e1b0239eb/download/paino.gif)

**PHOTO**

On the third floor, inside class 3-A, head to the camera and interact with it at midnight. The class will go dark and a girl will be around. Quickly look around and take a picture by clicking the screen before the time runs out. Do it 3 times and she’ll take a picture with you, winning the game.

![wonder.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4b2bc64e7316077f792/previews/6ad3f4cdbc64e7316078111d/download/wonder.gif)

**FINAL**

Once you complete ALL seven wonders, head to class 3-C near the board. You’ll then take a picture with all of the wonders together, meaning you’ve won!

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

---

# AWAKENING QUESTS

## JIN

**Stage 1 — Knockouts**

- Knock out 150 NPCs.

**Stage 2 — Counters**

- Perform 200 counters.

> → A counter requires you to perfect block an attack and then hit the same attacker within 2 seconds.

**Stage 3 — Meditation**

- Sit for 5 minutes straight on the Rooftop or in the Gardening area during nighttime.

> → You may sit on a seat or use the Sit emote.
> \-> Moving more than 2 studs, taking damage, or entering combat fails the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9ff07637fe57c59c301/previews/6ae4da0007637fe57c59c477/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## BOXING

**Stage 1 — M1s**

- Land 1,500 M1s against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Perfect Blocks**

- Perform 250 perfect blocks.

**Stage 3 — Shadowbox**

- Hit a punching bag in the Dojo Room nonstop for **3** minutes during nighttime.

> → No other players may be inside the Dojo Room.
> \-> Stopping for more than 2.5 seconds resets the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9a47d39f3e7f9539fd4/previews/6ae4d9a47d39f3e7f953a041/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## KARATE

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 400 full M1 combos on a punching bag.

**Stage 2 — Taimans**

- Win 5 taimans.

**Stage 3 — Rain Kata**

- Complete 60 full M1 combos outdoors while it is raining or snowing.

> → No roof or other object may be above you within 60 studs.
> \-> Combos against punching bags or fair opponents both count.
> \-> Progress is saved like a normal counter.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9b590587811402b95db/previews/6ae4d9b690587811402b9621/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## TAIJUTSU

**Stage 1 — Punching Bag Hits**

- Land 2,000 hits on punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Sprinting**

- Sprint 60,000 studs on foot.

> → Must be completed on foot.
> \-> Sprinting while seated, riding a skateboard, or airborne does not count.

**Stage 3 — Gates**

- Land 600 hits on a punching bag in the Dojo Room.

> → Can be completed at any time of day.
> \-> Stopping for more than 5 seconds resets the trial.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d98127ed740a6072da1e/previews/6ae4d98227ed740a6072dc32/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## LETHWEI

**Stage 1 — Guardbreaks**

- Perform 300 guardbreaks.

**Stage 2 — Low-HP Victories**

- Win 15 fights while at low HP.

> → You must knock out your opponent while your HP is at 25% or lower.

**Stage 3 — Blood Oath**

- Defeat a Street Crew leader without blocking at any point during the fight.
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4da188c463b1b586225ee/previews/6ae4da198c463b1b58622694/download/image.webp)

---

## HAKARI

**Stage 1 — Momentum Rush**

- Trigger Momentum Rush 200 times.

> → Momentum Rush requires 4 clean M1s in a row.
> \-> You must have landed a fair hit within the last 3 seconds.

**Stage 2 — Critical Hits**

- Land 200 critical hits (M2).

**Stage 3 — Undefeated**

- Get 5 knockouts in a row.

> → The streak resets if you are knocked down or hit by a critical hit.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9df85fbadbb1d637dc3/previews/6ae4d9e085fbadbb1d637eb5/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## WRESTLING

**Stage 1 — NPC Critical Hits**

- Land your critical hit (M2) on NPCs 150 times.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Ring**

- Win 3 taimans in a row.

> → Losing a taiman resets the streak.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9ec886fbefd8a98cb77/previews/6ae4d9ec886fbefd8a98cbf0/download/image.webp)

> ‌

---

## MUAY THAI

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 300 full M1 combos against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Wai Kru**
Complete the following steps to win a taiman:

1. Start a taiman against an opponent.
2. Face your opponent and use the Bow emote while within 25 studs and in front of them.
3. Land your first hit within 20 seconds of bowing.
4. Win the taiman.

**Important:** Hitting your opponent before bowing fails the attempt.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ada588c2a547b3d1b34db64/attachments/6ae4d9cbaecb8c580acff4ef/previews/6ae4d9cbaecb8c580acff62f/download/image.webp)

## Kure

s**tage 1 - land 120 heavy on npc/players**

‌

---

## AWAKENED

Complete all three stages of your chosen fighting style to master its Awakening and automatically activate it’s V2.

> Remember to check your characters inner thoughts for hints when completing Stages 2 and 3, as these stages do not display a progress counter.

old.desc:
The Manga Shop is located just outside of Nishikata High, nearby Dante's Yakiniku. Within the shop, you may pick up a Red Basket by the door. It is required to be holding one before you are able to pick out any manga volumes. Many shelves can be found within the shop, where you can browse through available manga; if you have a basket in hand, you may pick one to place in the basket (you can only have one in the basket at once). Once you have a manga volume in your basket, you may interact with the cashier at the front desk to pay for it. The transaction will complete immediately. With the manga in hand, you are able to open it to view its contents and flip through the pages as desired. When you are done with it, it can be placed down / dropped just like most other interactable items. If you attempt to leave the Manga Shop with a manga volume in the basket without paying, an alarm will sound, and your stolen goods will be returned.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ae6624fb5cbf21c93252a81/attachments/6ae6658a3db1cb75ef2d8c14/previews/6ae6658b3db1cb75ef2d8c94/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ae6624fb5cbf21c93252a81/attachments/6ae6657cf93d5be735598b42/previews/6ae6657df93d5be735598cd0/download/image.webp)

**The following manga volumes can be purchased within the Manga Shop:  (Each volume costs ¥550)**

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **8 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling and Muay Thai.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

old.desc:
There are 5 clubs you can choose from, join one at its board in the club room. The 5 clubs include Biology Club, Calligraphy Club, Astronomy Club, Gardening Club, and Light Music Club.

Club uniforms can be accessed at any time from their respective club boards after reaching 1,000 points in that club.

‌

**Biology Club**

The Biology club is found on the first floor to the left of the entrance and beside the locker area. Upon joining the biology club, your task for getting points is finding specimen via the microscope. You unlock more specimens to find as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac18155422926300b517a94/previews/6ac18156422926300b517ae0/download/image.webp)

Biology Club Uniforms

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1826c77061b922a4638de/previews/6ac1826d77061b922a463b5f/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1a68e386a6ecddafe7e17/previews/6ac1a68f386a6ecddafe7f18/download/image.webp)

**Calligraphy Club**

The Calligraphy club is found on the first floor right infront of the biology room and beside the stairs on the left. Upon joining the calligraphy club, your task for getting points is writing calligraphy. The calligraphy that you have to write is random. You unlock more kanji to write as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1892468629eac5381ba97/previews/6ac1892568629eac5381bb6f/download/image.webp)

Calligraphy Club Uniforms

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1828ca82be87266be6ad4/previews/6ac1828da82be87266be6b61/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac182905add61373b8ffcca/previews/6ac182915add61373b8ffd65/download/image.webp)

**Gardening Club**

The Gardening club is found on the right wing of the Gakuran building on the roof. Upon joining the gardening club, your task for getting points is taking care of them by giving the water they need, making sure they get enough sunlight, and removing bugs if there are any.

The maximum amount plants that you can take care of in one bed is three plants and you unlock more seeds to plant as you level up. It is recommended to do this club activity when the sun is up so you won't have to worry about the sunlight part of the activity, making it easier for you to complete it. You can abandon the responsibility of taking care of the plants by giving up your bed using the button on the upper right corner.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac18598a043a53fbb2c5862/previews/6ac18599a043a53fbb2c5935/download/image.webp)

Gardening Club Uniforms

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac185a892da01f6711d08be/previews/6ac185a992da01f6711d0979/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac185ac27e9280ecc82324b/previews/6ac185ac27e9280ecc823316/download/image.webp)

**Astronomy Club**

The Astronomy Club is found on the third floor of the school, upon joining the astronomy club you go to any available telescope and interact with it, when interacting with it you the get given a starry image in the bottom left, that you need to connect the dots (stars) with, upon completion you earn points that work towards your club, astrology also unlocks planets that show in the sky.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1abb14dd911ae3e6aaa5a/previews/6ac1abb14dd911ae3e6aabcb/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1abea7c2f5d4fa973e1fd/previews/6ac1abeb7c2f5d4fa973e326/download/image.webp)

**The Light Music Club**

The Light Music Club is found on the 3rd floor of the school, when arriving at the club you get to play songs for "points", points are based of difficulty of songs, ranging from easy-extreme, extreme giving the most points.

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **8 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling and Muay Thai.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

---

# AWAKENING QUESTS

## JIN

**Stage 1 — Knockouts**

- Knock out 150 NPCs.

**Stage 2 — Counters**

- Perform 200 counters.

> → A counter requires you to perfect block an attack and then hit the same attacker within 2 seconds.

**Stage 3 — Meditation**

- Sit for 5 minutes straight on the Rooftop or in the Gardening area during nighttime.

> → You may sit on a seat or use the Sit emote.
> \-> Moving more than 2 studs, taking damage, or entering combat fails the trial.

---

## BOXING

**Stage 1 — M1s**

- Land 1,500 M1s against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Perfect Blocks**

- Perform 250 perfect blocks.

**Stage 3 — Shadowbox**

- Hit a punching bag in the Dojo Room nonstop for **3** minutes during nighttime.

> → No other players may be inside the Dojo Room.
> \-> Stopping for more than 2.5 seconds resets the trial.

---

## KARATE

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 400 full M1 combos on a punching bag.

**Stage 2 — Taimans**

- Win 5 taimans.

**Stage 3 — Rain Kata**

- Complete 60 full M1 combos outdoors while it is raining or snowing.

> → No roof or other object may be above you within 60 studs.
> \-> Combos against punching bags or fair opponents both count.
> \-> Progress is saved like a normal counter.

---

## TAIJUTSU

**Stage 1 — Punching Bag Hits**

- Land 2,000 hits on punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Sprinting**

- Sprint 60,000 studs on foot.

> → Must be completed on foot.
> \-> Sprinting while seated, riding a skateboard, or airborne does not count.

**Stage 3 — Gates**

- Land 600 hits on a punching bag in the Dojo Room.

> → Can be completed at any time of day.
> \-> Stopping for more than 5 seconds resets the trial.

---

## LETHWEI

**Stage 1 — Guardbreaks**

- Perform 300 guardbreaks.

**Stage 2 — Low-HP Victories**

- Win 15 fights while at low HP.

> → You must knock out your opponent while your HP is at 25% or lower.

**Stage 3 — Blood Oath**

- Defeat a Street Crew leader without blocking at any point during the fight.

---

## HAKARI

**Stage 1 — Momentum Rush**

- Trigger Momentum Rush 200 times.

> → Momentum Rush requires 4 clean M1s in a row.
> \-> You must have landed a fair hit within the last 3 seconds.

**Stage 2 — Critical Hits**

- Land 200 critical hits (M2).

**Stage 3 — Undefeated**

- Get 5 knockouts in a row.

> → The streak resets if you are knocked down or hit by a critical hit.

---

## WRESTLING

**Stage 1 — NPC Critical Hits**

- Land your critical hit (M2) on NPCs 150 times.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Ring**

- Win 3 taimans in a row.

> → Losing a taiman resets the streak.

---

## MUAY THAI

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 300 full M1 combos against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Wai Kru**
Complete the following steps to win a taiman:

1. Start a taiman against an opponent.
2. Face your opponent and use the Bow emote while within 25 studs and in front of them.
3. Land your first hit within 20 seconds of bowing.
4. Win the taiman.

**Important:** Hitting your opponent before bowing fails the attempt.

---

## AWAKENED

Complete all three stages of your chosen fighting style to master its Awakening and automatically activate it’s V2.

> Remember to check your characters inner thoughts for hints when completing Stages 2 and 3, as these stages do not display a progress counter.

# **Basketball:**

is a skill-based activity focused on **timing, ball control, positioning, and defensive pressure**. Basketballs can be found on the racks near the hoop.

**Shooting:**

- Hold `E` to begin your shooting motion - a shot meter starts filling
- Release `E` to shoot
- The timing of your release determines the quality of the shot.
- Press Shift + Spacebar to perform a Dunk near the rim
- Shift + Tapping `E` to perform a Euro Step Dunk
- Press `G` to post up, `G+E` allows you to do a Post Fadeaway

## Power Meter Settings

Choose the style of the **Power Meter** that appears beside you whenever your basketball power changes. **Available Power Meters:**

- BALL • BATTERY • BLADE • CLASSIC
- DIAL • ENSO • GAUGE • HANABI
- HOLO • HOOP • KI • LAMPS
- MILK • MINI • RETICLE • RHYTHM
- OFF

**Shot Meter Zones**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6ac16b60b79679d36c1f2576/previews/6ac16b61b79679d36c1f2653/download/image.webp)

**Three-Point Scoring**
On both the Courtyard and Indoor Basketball courts, there are large semi-circles(the yellow line indoors and one of the white lines in the courtyard) that form a perimeter around the hoops on each side of the court.

These semi-circles are your **Three-Point Lines**.

They represent the perimeter by which any shot made past them(closer to the half-court line) will count for 3 points, however any shots made closer to the goal will instead only court for 2 points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211c34/previews/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211cde/download/image.webp)

---

**Defensive Pressure:**
Shot timing isn't the only factor. An active defender's positioning and pressure can reduce the shooter's chance of making the basket.

- Open shots are easier to make.
- Lightly contested shots are more difficult.
- Heavily contested shots are significantly harder to score.
- Strong pressure can lower shooting effectiveness even on otherwise decent releases.

Creating space before shooting is often just as important as timing the shot itself.

**Ball Handling:**
Several dribble moves let you create separation and outmaneuver defenders.

- `X` — Bounce-Back Dribble
- `Z + X` — Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `C + X` — Alternate Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `Backspace` — Drop the Ball
- Ball in right hand, `C+C`  — Right Spin Move
- Ball in left hand, `Z+Z`— Left Spin Move
- `Z or X` — Swap ball to other hand.
- Client Sided Numbers are assigned to teammates, pressing a corresponding number allows you to pass to the teammate

![basketballskill.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8d31bb2586ae699c082482/previews/6a8d31cd2586ae699c082df3/download/basketballskill.gif)

Combining dribble moves helps break through defenses and create open shooting opportunities.

**Defense:**
Defense plays a major role in stopping opponents from scoring.

- `RMB` (Right Mouse Button) — Defensive Stance
- `F` — Screen (Off-Ball)
- `R`— Steal (Off-Ball)
- `Space` — Block (Off-Ball)

Holding `RMB` puts your character in a defensive stance, letting you guard the ball handler, contest shots, cut off driving lanes, and apply pressure. The closer and more effectively you defend, the harder their shot becomes.

---

# Basketball

## **Call Play Menu**

When pressing `G` while in **Basketball Mode**, you are able to call out different plays. **Call Outs When Holding the Basketball:**

- Iso!

**Call Outs When Not Holding the Basketball:**

- Pass!
- Alley-Oop!

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6aaefbae53fa2c44ac424a81/previews/6aaefbaf53fa2c44ac424b44/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6aaefbb2debf0f425bd6bd12/previews/6aaefbb3debf0f425bd6be26/download/image.webp)

---

**Multiplayer Gameplay:**
There are two basketball courts: the indoor Gymnasium Court and the Outside Basketball Court. The Outside Basketball Court supprts a maximum of 6 players (3vs3). The inside Gymnasium Court supports either 6 or 10 players (3v3 or 5v5).

For 3v3, the players must stand on the 3 spots closest to the hoop on their side. For 5v5, the players can stand on any of the available spots.

The shot clock lasts 24 seconds per possession. After a rebound or if the ball goes out the bounds, the shot clock pauses. Each quarter lasts 5 minutes for a total game time of 20 minutes (4x5).

‌

**PS+ Settings:**

Within the PS+ command panel there is a section for basketball featuring many customization options such as:

Team

Team Customization

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a788e20462c7fa36ff1288d/previews/6a788e21462c7fa36ff12900/download/image.webp)

Game timing

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a788e3c2e928ca56e25f020/previews/6a788e3d2e928ca56e25f299/download/image.webp)

Score

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a788e4911f911b1eedc143d/previews/6a788e4911f911b1eedc14ce/download/image.webp)

And shot clock

# Recommended Build:

For the wrestling style a Tall height [around 6’0 / 183cm or higher] is recommended to take advantage of the “Takedown” and “Heavy Hitter” Perks, along with “Guard Pierce” Perk as well. Being tall gives you extra damage, and combined with the 50% extra damage from M2s join together to deal massive damage.
An extremely aggressive playstyle should almost definitely be played to take advantage of the aforementioned Takedown + Tall combo for high damage, as well as the “Resilience” Perk making reckless attacking less risky. old.desc:
To open the PS+ Command panel, open the left menu and select “Commands.”

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaef9ee93ad8c3a9b6c0ef9/previews/6aaef9ef93ad8c3a9b6c1165/download/image.webp)

### Server Commands:

Once the command panel is open, you are greeted by a few miscellaneous server options. First, are the weather and time of day, which can be controlled via slider and buttons.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa07558cd9e95e69fa44/previews/6aaefa07558cd9e95e69fcc1/download/image.webp)

On the second half of the miscellaneous server options, you are able to do two types of announcements: Proximity and Server. Server announcements send messages to the entire server, while proximity announcements send messages to those around (via a controlled radius). More specifically, it will send messages to people that are within a given distance around you. The unit of measurement used is studs.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa164a88cccc625e44a3/previews/6aaefa164a88cccc625e4731/download/image.webp)

#### **How do games work:**


in the private, there's a new section called "modes" pressing it will give you 6 choices, pressing each mode button will make a small message appear of how everything works.

![modes.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6ada7ecfd6be0da92e3d46f5/previews/6ada7ed0d6be0da92e3d4b4c/download/modes.webp)

‌

#### Gang War

Two gangs fight with respawns enabled. Knocking an enemy down gives 1 point, while gripping them gives 2. The first gang to reach the score limit wins, or the gang with the most points when time runs out. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Otherwise, they bleed out after 20 seconds and respawn at base.

#### Turf War

Three zones are placed across the map: A near one base, B in the middle, and C near the other base. Stand in a zone without enemies to capture it, with teammates making the process faster. Held zones give 1 point per second, while capturing a zone, knocking an enemy down, or finishing them off gives 5 points. Capturing a zone costs the leading side 20 points. Once the score limit is reached, the losing side enters the breaking phase, where downed players can no longer respawn.

#### Raid

One side attacks the school while the other defends it. Raiders must escort a truck to the front gate. It only moves when a raider is nearby and no defenders are close. The truck is destroyed after taking 60 hits. Once the gate falls, raiders push into the courtyard and fight the remaining defenders, including the Banchou, who has extra health and cannot respawn in the final phase. Raiders share a limited respawn pool. Defenders win if the truck is destroyed, the respawns run out, or time expires.

#### Last Gang Standing

A team-based mode with no respawns. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Getting gripped or bleeding out after 20 seconds eliminates you for the rest of the round. The side with the last player standing wins, or the side with more survivors when time runs out. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match.

#### Taiman

A 1v1 or 2v2 fight that starts where the players are, with a crowd watching nearby. There are no respawns, and the last side standing wins the round. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match. Both sides must have the same number of players to start.

#### Hatatori

Three flags are placed around the map. Hold the button to pick one up, then bring it to your side's shrine to secure it. Enemies can steal secured flags, and getting knocked down makes you drop the flag you're carrying. Dropped flags return to their starting spot after 30 seconds. Hold all three flags for the required time to win, or have the most secured flags when time runs out.

## NPC Events

> Automobiles (of various colors and models) can be found driven by NPCs on the roads outside of Nishikata High—this includes: smaller two-door cars, four-door cars, small trucks, small vans, semi-trucks, and taxis.

Running into vehicles moving at a substantial speed will cause you to take damage, knockback, and you'll be ragdolled for a couple of seconds.

Whilst riding a skateboard, moving in close proximity to the rear end of a vehicle (with the exception of semi-trucks) will force your character to grab onto one of the rear corners of the vehicle, allowing you to hitch a ride by hanging on. You can stop this action at any time by simply tapping "s" (backward movement key).

You are able to attack vehicles with your fists—they aren't destructible, but the NPC inside the vehicle will show dialogue in complaint to your actions.
In some cases, continuing to attack the vehicle will result in the NPC exiting the vehicle and aggroing you.
If enough damage to the NPC is dealt, they will re-enter the vehicle and flee the scene.

`Sharpshooter` - Your jump shot green window is 10% wider.

`Posterizer` - Take off for a running dunk 5 studs further from the rim.
`Heat Check` - Each make in a row widens your green window 3.3%, up to 3 in a row. A miss resets it.
`Lockdown` - Your contest count 15% more.
`Dimer` - Your passes fly 55% faster and are caught from 5.5 studs further.

#### **Uncommon:**

`Shooter's Touch` - Yellow and orange releases are 5 points likelier to go in.
`Ice Veins` - While your team is down for 5 or more, your green windows are 7% wider.
`Pickpocket` - Your steals are 5 points likelier to work.
`Tough Shot` - Defenders contesting your shot count 5% less.
`Catch and Shoot` - Shoot a jumper within 2 seconds of catching a pass and its green window is 5% wider.
`Ankle Breaker` - Your dribble moves are 4.4 points likelier to break ankles.
`Speed Dribbler` - Run 5% faster with the ball.
`Hang Time` - Stay in the air 20% longer without jumping any higher.
`Rim Protector` - Your Blocks are 5 points likelier to work.
`Slasher` - Layup, close shot, floater and hook windows are 8.8% wider.

#### **Common:**

`Lob City` - A teammate who catches your lob can take off for a dunk 1.65 studs further out for 2 seconds.
`Springs` - Dunk 10% higher, and your blocks reach 10% further.
`Planted` - Dribble moves are 4.4 points less likely to break your ankles.
`Iron Lungs` - Stamina refills 11% faster.
`Fast Feet` - Sprint 5% faster.
`Pogo` - Jump again 25% sooner after landing.
`Tight Handles` - Steals against you are 3.3 points less likely.

# Sport Traits

Each sport (Basketball, Volleyball, Soccer) features two active trait slots to modify your playstyle.

- **Primary Slot:** Operates at 100% full strength.
- **Sub Slot:** Operates at 75% strength.
- **Swapping:** Switch traits between the two slots at any time.
- **Rerolls:** Costs ¥250 or 1 Ticket.

> A reroll will never land on the trait active in your other slot.

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **8 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling and Muay Thai.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

####

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

---

# AWAKENING QUESTS

## JIN

**Stage 1 — Knockouts**

- Knock out 150 NPCs.

**Stage 2 — Counters**

- Perform 200 counters.

> → A counter requires you to perfect block an attack and then hit the same attacker within 2 seconds.

**Stage 3 — Meditation**

- Sit for 5 minutes straight on the Rooftop or in the Gardening area during nighttime.

> → You may sit on a seat or use the Sit emote.
> \-> Moving more than 2 studs, taking damage, or entering combat fails the trial.

---

## BOXING

**Stage 1 — M1s**

- Land 1,500 M1s against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Perfect Blocks**

- Perform 250 perfect blocks.

**Stage 3 — Shadowbox**

- Hit a punching bag in the Dojo Room nonstop for **3** minutes during nighttime.

> → No other players may be inside the Dojo Room.
> \-> Stopping for more than 2.5 seconds resets the trial.

---

## KARATE

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 400 full M1 combos on a punching bag.

**Stage 2 — Taimans**

- Win 5 taimans.

**Stage 3 — Rain Kata**

- Complete 60 full M1 combos outdoors while it is raining or snowing.

> → No roof or other object may be above you within 60 studs.
> \-> Combos against punching bags or fair opponents both count.
> \-> Progress is saved like a normal counter.

---

## TAIJUTSU

**Stage 1 — Punching Bag Hits**

- Land 2,000 hits on punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Sprinting**

- Sprint 60,000 studs on foot.

> → Must be completed on foot.
> \-> Sprinting while seated, riding a skateboard, or airborne does not count.

**Stage 3 — Gates**

- Land 600 hits on a punching bag in the Dojo Room.

> → Can be completed at any time of day.
> \-> Stopping for more than 5 seconds resets the trial.

---

## LETHWEI

**Stage 1 — Guardbreaks**

- Perform 300 guardbreaks.

**Stage 2 — Low-HP Victories**

- Win 15 fights while at low HP.

> → You must knock out your opponent while your HP is at 25% or lower.

**Stage 3 — Blood Oath**

- Defeat a Street Crew leader without blocking at any point during the fight.

---

## HAKARI

**Stage 1 — Momentum Rush**

- Trigger Momentum Rush 200 times.

> → Momentum Rush requires 4 clean M1s in a row.
> \-> You must have landed a fair hit within the last 3 seconds.

**Stage 2 — Critical Hits**

- Land 200 critical hits (M2).

**Stage 3 — Undefeated**

- Get 5 knockouts in a row.

> → The streak resets if you are knocked down or hit by a critical hit.

---

## WRESTLING

**Stage 1 — NPC Critical Hits**

- Land your critical hit (M2) on NPCs 150 times.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Ring**

- Win 3 taimans in a row.

> → Losing a taiman resets the streak.

---

## MUAY THAI

**Stage 1 — Full M1 Combos**

- Complete 300 full M1 combos against fair opponents or punching bags.

**Stage 2 — Clashes**

- Win 100 clashes.

**Stage 3 — Wai Kru**
Complete the following steps to win a taiman:

1. Start a taiman against an opponent.
2. Face your opponent and use the Bow emote while within 25 studs and in front of them.
3. Land your first hit within 20 seconds of bowing.
4. Win the taiman.

**Important:** Hitting your opponent before bowing fails the attempt.

---

## AWAKENED

Complete all three stages of your chosen fighting style to master its Awakening and automatically activate it’s V2.

> Remember to check your characters inner thoughts for hints when completing Stages 2 and 3, as these stages do not display a progress counter.

**DARUMA**

Daruma is the big statue outside the school. Once midnight arrives and you speak to it, it’ll make you play a game of red light, green light. At the top of the screen you’ll notice big text saying “Da Ru Ma.” You can walk while the text isn’t finished, but once he finishes saying “Daruma,” he’ll look back and teleport anyone who is moving back to the start. You get 2 chances.

![expomrt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad413a652a2eba459ca6f95/download/expomrt.gif)

**SKELETON**

At midnight in the biology club, when you press on the skeleton, it’ll begin to shake and drop all of its parts. Pick them all up and put them back one by one to win.

![skeelton.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f3f5dad82a0f81bf5ab5/previews/6ad3f41ddad82a0f81bf872a/download/skeelton.gif)

**BACKROOMS**

On the left stairs of the school, find the sign that says “No Running.” Once you count each stair by pressing the button at midnight, you’ll be teleported to a maze with a monster. Start searching for an elevator, and listen for the character saying “An elevator, here?” in case you miss it. Once you press on the elevator, it’ll take up to 10 seconds for the doors to open. Step in to win.

On the right side of the stairs, you’ll find a mirror as you climb. Interact with it at midnight and you’ll go to a different place where you have to click on the mirror that isn’t copying you. Look for things like twitching, moving differently, acting strangely, or even missing something. Once you find the right one, you’ll win.

![mirror.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f549491c1a924aa36d1f/download/mirror.gif)

**BATHROOM KNOCKS**

In the girls’ bathroom on the second floor, head to the first toilet and interact with it at midnight to start a minigame. You’ll have to find a girl 3 times among the 3 bathroom doors to win. Listen to the knocks and her laugh, and guess correctly to win.

![toilet.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4eec66d70f58473ce6d/previews/6ad3f526c66d70f5847404bf/download/toilet.gif)

**PIANO**

At midnight, the piano in the third-floor music room will summon a girl when you interact with it. She’ll make you press some notes in a pattern. Do it correctly and you’ll win.

![paino.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad41406a5da975e1b0200fe/previews/6ad41431a5da975e1b0239eb/download/paino.gif)

**PHOTO**

On the third floor, inside class 3-A, head to the camera and interact with it at midnight. The class will go dark and a girl will be around. Quickly look around and take a picture by clicking the screen before the time runs out. Do it 3 times and she’ll take a picture with you, winning the game.

![wonder.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4b2bc64e7316077f792/previews/6ad3f4cdbc64e7316078111d/download/wonder.gif)

**FINAL**

Once you complete ALL seven wonders, head to class 3-C near the board. You’ll then take a picture with all of the wonders together, meaning you’ve won!

## Candy Shop

This is a Limited Time shop that requires candy in order to purchase accessories/costumes for the Halloween season.

Candy can be acquired by doing numerous mini-events around the map that will be listed below!

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f74d257f662d2d5948b0/previews/6ad3f74e257f662d2d594946/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3edf8d59e6702d352cc95/previews/6ad3edf9d59e6702d352cd45/download/image.webp)

---

## Trick or Treating

Run around the map and walk up to different houses in order to active the prompt!

2 options:
Toilet Paper 3x - Rewards Candy
Trick or Treat - Rewards Candy

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3eeeaef2ed4045814865e/previews/6ad3eeebef2ed404581486d6/download/image.webp)

**Toilet Paper**

![ezgif-15701b61cd6ee51d.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3fda2f4781988b9c556f6/previews/6ad3fdb9f4781988b9c56dda/download/ezgif-15701b61cd6ee51d.gif)

**Trick or Treat**

![ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4072cd15d8a92d0b8efd8/previews/6ad40741d15d8a92d0b90272/download/ezgif-2b9f0fe48ed6efd2.gif)

‌

---

**DARUMA**

Daruma is the big statue outside the school. Once midnight arrives and you speak to it, it’ll make you play a game of red light, green light. At the top of the screen you’ll notice big text saying “Da Ru Ma.” You can walk while the text isn’t finished, but once he finishes saying “Daruma,” he’ll look back and teleport anyone who is moving back to the start. You get 2 chances.

![expomrt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad413a652a2eba459ca6f95/download/expomrt.gif)

**SKELETON**

At midnight in the biology club, when you press on the skeleton, it’ll begin to shake and drop all of its parts. Pick them all up and put them back one by one to win.

![skeelton.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f3f5dad82a0f81bf5ab5/previews/6ad3f41ddad82a0f81bf872a/download/skeelton.gif)

**BACKROOMS**

On the left stairs of the school, find the sign that says “No Running.” Once you count each stair by pressing the button at midnight, you’ll be teleported to a maze with a monster. Start searching for an elevator, and listen for the character saying “An elevator, here?” in case you miss it. Once you press on the elevator, it’ll take up to 10 seconds for the doors to open. Step in to win.

![backrooms.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f46d27afa407d114559c/previews/6ad3f48e27afa407d1147232/download/backrooms.gif)

**MIRROR WORLD**

On the right side of the stairs, you’ll find a mirror as you climb. Interact with it at midnight and you’ll go to a different place where you have to click on the mirror that isn’t copying you. Look for things like twitching, moving differently, acting strangely, or even missing something. Once you find the right one, you’ll win.

![mirror.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f549491c1a924aa36d1f/download/mirror.gif)

**BATHROOM KNOCKS**

In the girls’ bathroom on the second floor, head to the first toilet and interact with it at midnight to start a minigame. You’ll have to find a girl 3 times among the 3 bathroom doors to win. Listen to the knocks and her laugh, and guess correctly to win.

![toilet.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4eec66d70f58473ce6d/previews/6ad3f526c66d70f5847404bf/download/toilet.gif)

**PIANO**

At midnight, the piano in the third-floor music room will summon a girl when you interact with it. She’ll make you press some notes in a pattern. Do it correctly and you’ll win.

![paino.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad41406a5da975e1b0200fe/previews/6ad41431a5da975e1b0239eb/download/paino.gif)

**PHOTO**

On the third floor, inside class 3-A, head to the camera and interact with it at midnight. The class will go dark and a girl will be around. Quickly look around and take a picture by clicking the screen before the time runs out. Do it 3 times and she’ll take a picture with you, winning the game.

![wonder.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad3f4b2bc64e7316077f792/previews/6ad3f4cdbc64e7316078111d/download/wonder.gif)

**FINAL**

Once you complete ALL seven wonders, head to class 3-C near the board. You’ll then take a picture with all of the wonders together, meaning you’ve won!

![exportt.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ad4143e4f522f3f5a468ad7/download/exportt.gif)

card.desc:
\+ THE SEVEN WONDERS OF NISHIKATA HIGH
`   + after midnight the school wakes up... the piano plays itself, the 13th step appears, Hanako knocks from the third stall, the anatomy model walks, the statue counts, the mirror opens at 3:33 & the old class photo has someone extra in it`
`   + every wonder gives candy & a keepsake, find all seven for a big bonus`
`   + ...and then there's the eighth. find all seven and something waits for you in class 3-C`
`   + rumours, lore & hints in the candy shop: who was 八重, and what happened in 1969?`
`   + start a wonder and anyone nearby gets an invite to join you`
\+ TRICK OR TREAT
`   + knock on house doors around town, real residents answer with candy... but not every house is friendly`
`   + toilet paper a house instead, but the family might come out to steal your candy back or fight you`
`   + wear halloween items for a costume bonus (up to +75% treat candy)`
\+ CANDY SHOP ━ masks, costumes, horns, wings, tails, ears & more, plus your wonder keepsakes
`   + halloween items leave on halloween night, then the shop turns into PART 2 with permanent rewards. your candy carries over, so save it 👀`
\+ Kuchisake-onna (beat her for 10 rerolls), zombie raids at the school gate, test of guts & the spirit parade
\+ halloween decorations, pumpkins, cauldrons, cobwebs & a blood moon over the school

---

- + BREAKABLES ━ fights smash windows, knock over chairs, benches, bins, cones & rooftop plant pots (they put themselves back)
  \+ GAME MODES in private servers (Gang War, Turf War, Raid, Last Gang Standing, Taiman & Hatatori) ━ MODES tab in the server panel
  `# perfect copy: punches faster again & its grab can't be knocked out of the windup`
  `# mishima: punches faster again`
  `# awakened taijutsu: crit comes out faster`
  `# karate: crit hits a little softer & reach back to normal, hyper armor only on the awakened V2`
  `# hakari: crit no longer near-instant for short players`
  `# aikido & hikaken: tall players punch a little slower`
  `# awakened boxing crit CD 7s -> 10s`
  `# taimans show up less often (about every 8-15 min)`

---

- + feet planting (experimental)
  `# cars stop waiting forever on someone standing in the road`
  `# firstperson eyepatch visual revamped`
  `# phones draw less faraway car traffic for better FPS`

---

- + Sports Queue app on your phone: matchmake globally for basketball, soccer or volleyball
  \+ auto matches open like a TV broadcast: intros, player cards & a replay of the best moments
  `# soccer ball physics remade, plus new soccer sound effects`
  `# soccer field +15% bigger`
  `# soccer NPC goalkeepers difficulty reduced`
  `# curve shots only bend now instead of flying further`
  `# kicks, tackles & keeper dives reach a little further ahead while you run`

---

- + 19 new rhythm songs (A Turtle's Heart, Ash Again, Asphyxia, Bury The Light, Cubibibibism, Drank-Dazed, Esok, Extradimensional Cosmic Phenomenon, Far Away Light, Figure09, I Want You Back, Last Night on Earth, love., Nevermind, out of bed, Some Things Never Change, Sometimes, The Whole Blue World, Wish to Drown)
  `   # able to sort the song wheel (A-Z, newest, level & length)`
  \+ 14 songs added to the music player
  \+ freecam button in the menu
  \+ daily rewards got a new look
  `# the server list now shows where each server is located`
  `# double confirmation before changing gender or rerolling away Cat Ears (pushed early)`

---

# `# fixed custom prompts (doors, grills, fridges & more) not showing or not working, and not working when tapped on mobile`
`# fixed players going invisible to each other when standing on the toilets`
`# fixed police chases never ending`
`# fixed players snapping, sliding or stuttering as they move`
`# fixed soccer keeper saves snapping back with lag`
`# fixed losing a grapple sending you forwards instead of backwards`
`# fixed your two hairs sharing one colour`
`# fixed private server greenzone changes only kicking in after you went to another area`
`# fixed not being able to drop flowers on mobile`
