## Covers every single in-game title and what do each do

‌

# **General titles:**

## Game creator:

Self explained. This is the MAIN person of the game, the one that had the idea and made it happen, it is only owned by the man himself. Not a huge change between the owner title, mostly a unique title to tell them apart.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_010609.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebba8145ac314d8a498bbb/previews/6aebba8145ac314d8a498c90/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_010609.webp)

‌

## Owner:

self explained. This is the owner of the game, the one that has the final say as to what needs to be added, removed, nerfed and goes on. They got every single perm meaning they can do everything.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235209.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aeba956cb7c92afce6ef130/previews/6aeba956cb7c92afce6ef279/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235209.webp)

## Developer:

Developers are the ones that created the game with the owner, each got their own line such as vfx effects, animations, creating a style, writing the bios, making the map and anything else. Developers are able to give themselves exclusive powers such as goku and make special events like zombie infection or freddy nightmare.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235251.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aeba9a72b0a4fb41c3b3b72/previews/6aeba9a72b0a4fb41c3b3b94/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235251.webp)

## Manager:

Manager is the one that handles the discord server, they create the channels, make sure everything works well, decides a promotion or manages the general sets of what’s allowed and what is not.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235242.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaa20fbc32748ff00f35b/previews/6aebaa21fbc32748ff00f388/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235242.webp)

## Senior staff:

Senior staff works with the manager to handle less important stuff, they handle teams such as the helper team, get to decide any future promotions with the manager, they’re the eyes of the server and a higher staff. The senior staff do not have access to summon any type of events like the developers. They’re simply the main staff that takes care of everyone and also got access to the death note.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235247.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaae10c57c896600839d7/previews/6aebaae10c57c89660083a39/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235247.webp)

## Staff:

Staff are one of the main reasons that the game is safe from exploiters. They fully take care of anything in-game, that includes anything that might break the rules such as weird names, exploits or anyone that might be a threat to the game/not allowed to play. They also take care of the server support tickets and get to decide who gets unbanned. They’re also one of the few people allowed to have a death note.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_000431.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebac06b6c3c5a95336593c/previews/6aebac06b6c3c5a9533659c3/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_000431.webp)

## Trial staff:

Trial staffs are pretty much staff in training that are trying to prove that they can be trusted. They mainly handle small in-server moderation such as warnings, bans, mutes to the people that break the rules in the server, these staff also have small perms in-game such as teleporting or becoming invisible. This is so in case they find any exploiters, which they can later forward it to a staff.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_001446.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebae70d1862514245614ba/previews/6aebae71d18625142456155b/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_001446.webp)

## Contributor:

Contributor are people who have contributed something significant to the game and its development. This can include skateboard art, gamemodes, bots, posters, and more. While initially a more frequently obtainable role in gakuran's early development, it is less likely to be recieved presently.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235300.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaf1b26437c7d7bb9c8cf/previews/6aebaf1b26437c7d7bb9ca5d/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235300.webp)

## Tester:

Testers are responsible in finding any type of bug before an update happens, they all gather and try everything possible and report it to the developers before the actual release. Their job is to find any major bugs, abuses,  minor bugs, lag issues, quality related bugs and anything that may have an issue or look off in-game. Although there’s too many bugs so not everything minor can be fixed on the update, this doesn’t mean that they do not know it. It simply means that it couldn’t be fixed in time and will be fixed in a different update.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_004717.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb6b54d78b07033e8a32c/previews/6aebb6b54d78b07033e8a757/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_004717.webp)

## QA Lead:

The lead testers, they responsible for making sure that testers do not leak, hand out the titles and get to pick the testers. They manage when everyone should gather and test and make sure that the owner knows any major bug. This is owned by 2 people which both have their own part in the team.

![imag1e.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbce3fbd4df3361d1eeee/previews/6aebbce3fbd4df3361d1f05e/download/imag1e.webp)

## Artist manager:

Artist managers handle the server's artists, they host unique artist events, giveaways, and make sure that each person who posts art follows the art guidelines. They are the ones that decide if you should have the artist role. As reward for their efforts they’re also  allowed to set themselves and only themselves so you may find that each of them have a unique and creative character.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235256.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb0162a6e66338fcfc62c/previews/6aebb0162a6e66338fcfc6d8/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235256.webp)

## Event host:

They’re responsible for any related events, this includes hosting fun events for rewards in the original gakuran server, hosting other events in competitive server, finding ideas, having conversations of what would people like, communicating with each other to make the event as fun as possible and the main part which is to make sure that everything goes smooth without anyone to ruin it. They also the ones that you need to talk to in case you planning to host a server giveaway in the channel.

![image1.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb87eb7d46caea1df2340/previews/6aebb87fb7d46caea1df23ff/download/image1.webp)

## Event manager:

Decides the events, gets to say the final choice before anything happens. The ones that decide who becomes an event host, explains the rules, lists the blacklisted people and manages the entire event team. As a reward for their effort, they also get the ability to set themselves so they can put a character that’d fit the specific event.

![2.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbc6878080be6364df57b/previews/6aebbc6978080be6364df665/download/2.webp)

## Charting manager:

Chart managers are the ones responsible of songs, they make sure what’s get added to rhythm games, manages the charting server and picks people for the chart team. This title is only for one person and only one.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235708.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb0a081f9b6ab6367273c/previews/6aebb0a181f9b6ab6367280f/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235708.webp)

## Song charter:

The song charters create the rhythm-game music and its gameplay, they chart songs, curate the difficulty, making sure every note is tied to the buttons you play in game. Song charters  are really hard working people that put all their effort into making the best possible songs playable and smooth.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235713.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb134f38579eefe881fd9/previews/6aebb135f38579eefe8820ee/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235713.webp)

## Japanify title:

This title is given to the ones that sing, similar to the song charter but instead of rhythm games they sing songs that they made themselves with their own voice which later gets added in-game. The title is one of the only ones that got different variants, the name is based on their original (spotify) name so you can easily search them up and find them for support. There’s also a small case where similar titles for popular singers was handed out that either sound similar or happen to win it. Those 2 are a little different because they did not sing or have an original spotify account, they just a small joke due to them winning a title like that.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235212.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb1a4a3366cf107525be6/previews/6aebb1a5a3366cf107525c65/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235212.webp)

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_011721.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbd08ba75427e2de32487/previews/6aebbd09ba75427e2de3276c/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_011721.webp)

## Trello team:

the ones that made all of this board, the one that’s writing this as you read. Trello team manages the new info right after an update and makes sure everyone is informed, they’re one of the people that know mostly everything, about 20 people own this title and they’re able to answer to all of your questions, feel free to suggest anything if you see them for the Trello. They’re here to make the game easier just for you, just like a helper

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_002143.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb2c488b4b4dfaf5f5cb8/previews/6aebb2c488b4b4dfaf5f5d41/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_002143.webp)

## Trello manager:

Trello manager is the one that handles the whole Trello, they make announcements, put the Trello team in order and they’re one of the ones that fully decide if something is really important for Trello or not. This title is owned by 1 person. They also the ones that get the final choice of who gets to be in the Trello and who gets to write the Trello.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_001451.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb37af87946c0a648bced/previews/6aebb37bf87946c0a648bd96/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_001451.webp)

## University Professor:

Professor title is the senior staff of the university server. They make sure to have events for content creators, handle server moderation and mainly putting things in order by answering cc related stuff, they take care of the main staff activity and usually decide who deserves to be a staff. As a reward for their effort they got a title to show their hard work.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235306.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb4c091c6fccd11d6c2bd/previews/6aebb4c091c6fccd11d6c374/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235306.webp)

## Content creator (cc):

They the ones that make videos in any platform for players to watch, they all got their own different rule and do what they like best, making pvp videos, showing methods, tricks and mainly content for people to enjoy.

![imag2e.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb945b3e53dcb7c5afd37/previews/6aebb947b3e53dcb7c5b0068/download/imag2e.webp)

## Content creator manager:

The ones that take care of the content creators. They decide who gets to have the role, give the cc sets, makes the rules, decides the events, does fun stuff for the game and also manage the main university server. Only 3 people own it.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_010511.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbb58677d3676045d829a/previews/6aebbb58677d3676045d83ae/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_010511.webp)

## Assistant CCM:

The assistant of the creator manager, they help the cc manager with anything small like answering content creators questions, help with the university server, talks with the manager about anything bad related to a cc and mainly handles stuff when the cc manager is busy.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-08\_020725.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aefcf02f85b4ec4efe3555f/previews/6aefcf03f85b4ec4efe356c3/download/Screenshot_2026-11-08_020725.webp)

‌

## Competitive overseer:

comp overseer is the manager of the competitive side in gakuran. They handle how things should work, checking cheaters and mainly look around the server for any major problems. They’re in charge of anything that has to do with the comp server and anything related to it.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee40387b232c9e66646cbe/previews/6aee40387b232c9e66646deb/download/image.webp)

‌

## Head of lore:

responsible for handling the gakuran “lore” and the manager of the closed community, they take care of anything lore related and they manage/hire the lore team.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee644a9d395d6e1cdc886e/previews/6aee644b9d395d6e1cdc8a93/download/image.webp)

## Lore team:

Responsible for making the lore of gakuran and closed community. They work together to create a small and lovely lore for everyone to enjoy.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee6489ee0a9c07a9782baf/previews/6aee6489ee0a9c07a9782cfc/download/image.webp)

---

## Winner titles:

## Drum master:

Drum Master is rewarded to the person that completed ALL songs in perfect without a single miss, they fully maxed all songs with 100% perfect score. Truly skilled rhythm players which is why it’s only rewarded to 1 single person.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235702.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb44255b959654a07ebb5/previews/6aebb44355b959654a07ec62/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235702.webp)

## Guitar master:

Guitar master is rewarded to the person that completed ALL songs in perfect without a single miss, they maxed all songs with 100% perfect score. It is owned by only 1 single person.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_151732.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aec8b698c451001b2f40407/previews/6aec8b6a8c451001b2f4052a/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_151732.webp)

## Rockstar:

rockstar was awarded in a official gakuran event, in a event of 5. All players in the event had to complete the hardest song, make a unique edit and had to be sure that the song was 100% perfect. Out of all the 2k entries, they ended up being the winner and earned the rockstar title.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-07\_001002.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee5cd32fa0e9b79458a88c/previews/6aee5cd32fa0e9b79458a9c5/download/Screenshot_2026-11-07_001002.webp)

## #1 Global Gang:

awarded to the top clan in the competitive server that climbed the ranks and beat the people that came to fight them. This title was awarded to the owner of the clan and it can be removed if his clan falls the ranks. This is one of the only titles that can be changed. (includes the top fighter)

![Screenshot\_2026-11-08\_010603.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aefcb8965b90b457cbe3c29/previews/6aefcb8a65b90b457cbe3dcc/download/Screenshot_2026-11-08_010603.webp)

## Permanent Candy Shop Overview

The candy shop in part 2 of the halloween event is all permanent items, to get these items you must either spend candies, or rerolls on capsules.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae66b0e633240a0746ed2ae/previews/6ae66b0f633240a0746ed3d3/download/image.webp)

You are able to get limited time faces, uniforms, styles, which can not be rerolled for and are permanent items, you can also get Ofuda which can be traded in for the limited time faces, uniforms and styles.

‌

- **Equipping/Slots:** You can have an option to choose a slot when you roll something, or equip it manually if you scroll down at the candy shop.
- **Toggle Feature:** All current available items such as face/uniforms are able to be toggled on/off at the candy shop with your currently existing items.
- **Post-Update Rule:** It is only after the event they are replacing your current slot. If they're not on you, you won't be able to put them on post-update. Even if you got them during the update.

---

## Ghost Gacha Odds & Pity System

Spend remaining Candy here (100 per single spin / 1000 for 10 spins)

You cannot earn new candy anymore.

- **Jackpot (0.2%):** Limited Styles (2 available: `jason` & `scarecrow`).
  - _Guaranteed Pity:_ You are guaranteed a jackpot by turn 350 at the latest.
- **Big Win (1.5%):** Halloween Faces (5 available: `red`, `blud`, `doll`, `bow`, `spider`).
- **Win (5.0%):** Halloween Fits (6 variations available).
- **Miss (93.3%):** +0 Ofuda (Base roll).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae682e6f84521a7944f0252/previews/6ae682e7f84521a7944f03b0/download/image.webp)

### **General Gacha Rules:**

- **No Dupes:** There are no duplicate drops. If you already own everything in a category, you will receive Ofuda instead.
- **Ofuda Income:** Every turn gives 1 Ofuda.
- **Daily Limit:** Maximum of 200 reroll turns allowed per day.
- **Deadline:** The entire Candy Shop and Gacha event closes in **7 days and.**
  \* Limited styles cannot be rerolled for, after the shop closes.

![1x.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae68277dc4fa4ed5e8e9b64/download/1x.gif)

---

## Ofuda Trade-In Shop

If you don't unlock the limited items via Gacha rolls, you can trade your accumulated Ofuda directly at the shop:

- **Limited Style:** 1200 Ofuda
- **Halloween Face:** 250 Ofuda
- **Halloween Uniform:** 80 Ofuda

cards.desc:
## **Before Joining the Game:**

Before joining the game, ensure that your Roblox account:

- Is verified as 16+
- Is in the [Roblox Group](https://www.roblox.com/communities/416091513/Gakuran#!/about "‌")

After you meet the previously listed requirements, you can join the game.

## **Once You Are in the Game:**

### Character Customization:

#### Gender:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50924c65a8578d5e50b189/attachments/6a50992c1500c26bd20a6183/previews/6a50992c1500c26bd20a61b0/download/image.webp)

Once you join, you will be greeted with a character creation screen. First, you must choose your gender: male or female. Please note that:

- **Gender affects height** (with males having a significantly higher average height then female)
- **Both genders have varying accessory pools**
- **Gender can be changed in the stat menu**

With that in mind, you can select a gender.

#### Name:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50924c65a8578d5e50b189/attachments/6a5099665cc68c87034707a9/previews/6a5099675cc68c87034707e0/download/image.webp)

After you select a gender, you must choose a name. Note that: last names are randomized and you do not get to choose it; however, you can change it via rolling. Furthermore, ensure that your name is not derogatory or breaks Roblox ToS. **If you get the error:**

> “Server Rejected Data”

It means:

- Your name was tagged by Roblox
- It broke one of the name rules

And you need to choose a different name.

### In the Game:

Once you are in the game your ethnicity, height, last name, accessories, hair, hair color, face are all randomized. You can now enjoy the game!
cards.name: How To Play

cards.desc:
# **PC:**

Move: W / A / S / D
Sprint: Hold Shift
Turn Camera: Move Mouse
Free Cam: Shift + P
Light Attack (M1): Left Click
Heavy Attack (M2): R
Block: Hold F
Parry: Click F
Dash: Q
Interact: E
Open Phone: Left Alt
Equip Fighting Style: T
Carry Downed Player: V
Execute/Grip Downed Player: B
Drop/Place Item: Backspace
Jump: Space
Shift-Lock: Ctrl
Open Emote Wheel: G
Swap POV: Tab

---

**Universal Chat commands:**

**/Me** : followed by a message, starts and ends your message with an asterisk (*_). Additionally_ **using an asterisk** before and after a message highlights the message in pink.

**/S** : followed by a message, makes a shouted/emphasized version of your message.

/**ooc** : followed by a message, makes the message appear cleanly with no effects or speaking lines.

**/w** : followed by a message, makes the message appear in italics and light gray text. The chat can only be read by people within 3m of the speaker, otherwise it appears as \*unintelligible\*.

**Mb / Mb all** : Clears _IN COMBAT_ status at the top of your screen. There are different conditions for this chat command to work. (Bow emote does this as well)

**If only you** attack someone and they didn’t hit back, only you have to say _Mb or Mb all_. **If another player** : attacks you by accident, they must say _Mb or Mb all_ to exit early **If both of you** : attack each other and then decide not to, both players must say it to leave /forgive combat early.

---

# **Console:**

Move: Left Stick
Sprint: Hold Left Trigger (LT / L2)
Turn Camera: Right Stick
Light Attack (M1): Right Trigger (RT / R2)
Heavy Attack (M2): Right Bumper (RB / R1)
Block: X Button / Square Button
Dash: B Button / Circle Button
Interact: X Button / Square Button
Open Phone: D-Pad Right
Equip Fighting Style: Left Bumper (LB / L1)
Carry Downed Player: D-Pad Up
Execute/Grip Downed Player: D-Pad Down
Drop/Place Item: D-Pad Up
Jump: A Button / Cross Button
Shift-Lock: Press Left Stick (L3)
Open Emote Wheel: D-Pad Left
Swap POV: Y Button / Triangle Button

cards.desc:
To report people who broke the rules in Gakuran, first ensure that they broke one of the following rules:

> - Explicit Drawings
> - Permanent Trapping Players
> - Prolonged Carrying of Other Players
> - Infinite Holding
> - Throwing individuals into the void
> - Bug Abuse
> - Exploiting
> - Extreme Harassment
> - Exploiter Affiliation

Please note that: W+Sing is no longer bannable, unless it is an intentionally sexual act and not an act of toxicity.

When you report a player, you need three things. The first two, come in the form of a clip (short video recorded capturing the rule break). Within the clip, **ensure that it clearly captures the rule break occur with the person's name, and that you then open the left player list and show their name as it corresponds to their username.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a55591a629547648456a198/attachments/6a555bd0a34be7b841e385bd/previews/6a555bd1a34be7b841e385da/download/image.webp)

The third thing that is necessary for a proper report, is **that the clip is uploaded somewhere. When reporting, it requires you submit a link as evidence**; so, ensure that you have one.

After that, please make sure that you are in the [Gakuran Support Server](https://discord.com/channels/1439650635011330138/1505497147934773399/1525884738710143029 "‌") and fill out the required fields in the report embed. For the use “Username” field, make sure **it's the person BEING reported**, not YOU.

If it says they are no longer taking reports to focus on the ones they have: It means that the support server is full. There is not an announcement for when they re-open; however, it re-opened on a daily basis, just stay diligent.

To open the PS+ Command panel, open the left menu and select “Commands.”

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaef9ee93ad8c3a9b6c0ef9/previews/6aaef9ef93ad8c3a9b6c1165/download/image.webp)

### Server Commands:

Once the command panel is open, you are greeted by a few miscellaneous server options. First, are the weather and time of day, which can be controlled via slider and buttons.

**Player's are able to move the commands tab around with the interactable slider on the top middle of the panel, along with the ability to readjust the panel size to the person's desired size, the re-adjustable button is on the bottom right corner.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6af1ec7c794e4037b1c3f9f4/previews/6af1ec7d794e4037b1c3fe92/download/image.webp)

‌

On the second half of the miscellaneous server options, you are able to do two types of announcements: Proximity and Server. Server announcements send messages to the entire server, while proximity announcements send messages to those around (via a controlled radius). More specifically, it will send messages to people that are within a given distance around you. The unit of measurement used is studs.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa164a88cccc625e44a3/previews/6aaefa164a88cccc625e4731/download/image.webp)

Lastly, there are a few global commands that are self-explanatory:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa22f88851f07a273dd4/previews/6aaefa22f88851f07a2740a3/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa294f874e6f20f0b4e6/previews/6aaefa2a4f874e6f20f0b809/download/image.webp)

### Individual player commands:

Next, is the “PLAYERS” tab, which allows for commands that can be used on singular persons.

The first tab is self-explanatory; it allows you to ban players for a determined duration:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa34458fd28255321602/previews/6aaefa35458fd282553219cf/download/image.webp)

**Players are now also given the ability to select multiple players at once and role them, or bring them, respawn, unfreeze, heal, and other actions.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6af1ecf78b998f8f7489259f/previews/6af1ecf88b998f8f74892e2b/download/image.webp)

‌

At the top of the "PLAYERS" tab, you can search and scroll through any active members within your server.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa3b8f99d82e05287e54/previews/6aaefa3b8f99d82e0528813f/download/image.webp)

You can also unban any banned players:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa41460a2a99d1c2f53e/previews/6aaefa42460a2a99d1c2fb02/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa4d6720f8fbbde702f7/previews/6aaefa4e6720f8fbbde705e0/download/image.webp)

By clicking on a player, you can run a multitude of commands on them, including:

**Actions:**

- Bring
- Go To
- Respawn
- Heal
- Kick
  **Role:**
- Set Role (Choose between all available roles created)
- Panel Access (Grants Admin)
  **State**:
- Godmode
- Freeze
- Invisible
- Fly
  **Sight:**
- ESP
- See other health bars
- Freecam range (5-5000)
  **Movement:**
- Walk speed (4-60)
- Reset Walk Speed
  **Ban:**
- Duration (Forever, 1-365 days)

### NPC Commands:

Under the “NPC” tab, you can spawn various NPCs with different purposes (including ones with AI). First, you can spawn a basic NPC that will sit in the seat nearest to you.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa53303c7dc9acaf4431/previews/6aaefa54303c7dc9acaf4832/download/image.webp)

The second command allows you to spawn 1-50 NPCs that will all sit at the nearest free seat (relative to you).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa9adda18707fa0717b3/previews/6aaefa9adda18707fa071b1a/download/image.webp)

The third command with spawn 1-120 NPC’s Infront of you in a crowd.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbee5cea27da300ca2f5/previews/6aaefbee5cea27da300ca64e/download/image.webp)

The fourth command will allow you to spawn NPCs on instruments; they will perform with you. For drummer and keyboard NPC’s they need a free instrument, the other type of performers will spawn with their instrument.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbf429277bdafaebfcc9/previews/6aaefbf629277bdafaec0307/download/image.webp)

The fifth command will spawn an Ally Squad of NPCs that will follow behind you. They can will also fight alongside you. You can command them with: “/s follow” and “/s attack”. You can also give them specific clothing.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbfa6c10d88e85403b7a/previews/6aaefbfb6c10d88e85403ebd/download/image.webp)

The last command allows you to remove the nearest NPC near you. You can also type their name to remove them.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefc0222366042b824ba5d/previews/6aaefc0222366042b824bdb0/download/image.webp)

### Role Commands:

You can create various roles within your private server that you can give other people (via the aforementioned player commands).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefc097cbc29bc72c14383/previews/6aaefc0a7cbc29bc72c146e5/download/image.webp)

You can customize the role color, if they have admin (panel access), and clothing.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefc118a6cc9d0648e95ce/previews/6aaefc118a6cc9d0648e999b/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefc180f90ca59a10cbba8/previews/6aaefc190f90ca59a10cbf29/download/image.webp)

### Area Commands:

The last panel allows you toggle green zones (safe zones) for different areas. It also shows where players are.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6af1ed3689fff0cef022358e/previews/6af1ed3789fff0cef0223a58/download/image.webp)

### Music Commands:

The first command under the music section allows you to paste song IDs to play. Pasting more than one will build a list with a queue.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefc24460a2a99d1c56b84/previews/6aaefc25460a2a99d1c57017/download/image.webp)

The Final Commands (Mix and Playback) allows you to skip, return, pause, play, songs. You can also control the speed and volume of the songs.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefcc147d53164f7ca0bcb/previews/6aaefcc247d53164f7ca1016/download/image.webp)

Within the PS+ command panel there is a section for basketball featuring many customization options such as:

#### **How do games work:**

in the private, there's a new section called "modes" pressing it will give you 6 choices, pressing each mode button will make a small message appear of how everything works.

![modes.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6ada7ecfd6be0da92e3d46f5/previews/6ada7ed0d6be0da92e3d4b4c/download/modes.webp)

‌

#### Gang War

Two gangs fight with respawns enabled. Knocking an enemy down gives 1 point, while gripping them gives 2. The first gang to reach the score limit wins, or the gang with the most points when time runs out. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Otherwise, they bleed out after 20 seconds and respawn at base.

#### Turf War

Three zones are placed across the map: A near one base, B in the middle, and C near the other base. Stand in a zone without enemies to capture it, with teammates making the process faster. Held zones give 1 point per second, while capturing a zone, knocking an enemy down, or finishing them off gives 5 points. Capturing a zone costs the leading side 20 points. Once the score limit is reached, the losing side enters the breaking phase, where downed players can no longer respawn.

#### Raid

One side attacks the school while the other defends it. Raiders must escort a truck to the front gate. It only moves when a raider is nearby and no defenders are close. The truck is destroyed after taking 60 hits. Once the gate falls, raiders push into the courtyard and fight the remaining defenders, including the Banchou, who has extra health and cannot respawn in the final phase. Raiders share a limited respawn pool. Defenders win if the truck is destroyed, the respawns run out, or time expires.

#### Last Gang Standing

A team-based mode with no respawns. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Getting gripped or bleeding out after 20 seconds eliminates you for the rest of the round. The side with the last player standing wins, or the side with more survivors when time runs out. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match.

#### Taiman

A 1v1 or 2v2 fight that starts where the players are, with a crowd watching nearby. There are no respawns, and the last side standing wins the round. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match. Both sides must have the same number of players to start.

#### Hatatori

Three flags are placed around the map. Hold the button to pick one up, then bring it to your side's shrine to secure it. Enemies can steal secured flags, and getting knocked down makes you drop the flag you're carrying. Dropped flags return to their starting spot after 30 seconds. Hold all three flags for the required time to win, or have the most secured flags when time runs out.

cards.desc:
##### Your characters height determines your hitbox size, attack speed and damage.

##### _Taller = **more** damage, **more** health, **larger** hitbox, **slower** attacks._

##### Shorter = **less** damage, **less** health, **smaller** hitbox, **faster** attacks.

---

## Technical buffs/debuffs

## Short vs. Tall Height Comparison

**📏 Minimum Height**

- **M1 Reach:** 5.10
- **M2 Reach:** 4.25
- **Damage:** 0.85x
- **Atk Speed:** 1.15x
- **M1 Width:** 3.40
- **Max HP:** 85
- **Heavy CD:**  CD / 1.15

**📐 Maximum Height**

- **M1 Reach:** 6.90
- **M2 Reach:** 5.75
- **Damage:** 1.15x
- **Atk Speed:** 0.95x
- **M1 Width:** 4.60
- **Max HP:** 115
- **Heavy CD:** CD / .85

The main advantage of **Height** is the box face growing — you get **much more lateral and vertical hitbox** than with Reach, plus a slight reach increase on top.

---

### Attack Speed

_Taller = **slower** swings, Shorter = **faster** swings_

- this includes combo reset timers, meaning shorter players attacking cooldowns are shorter.

### Damage

Taller = **more** damage, Shorter = **less** damage

- stacks with style damage.

### Hitbox Size

Taller = **larger** attack hitboxes, Shorter = **smaller** attack hitboxes

- easier to land hits when taller, can play ranged/distance playstyle

### Health

Taller = **more** health, Shorter = **less** health

- Not a _major difference or change in health unless extremely_ tall or _extremely_ short (base health = 100HP)

cards.desc:
**Posture = Stamina** | Movement uses it for sprinting (how long you can run) , combat uses it for blocking (how many attacks can be blocked before you are guardbroken), in addition Sprinting & Blocking hits both drain posture.

- **Posture:**
  Prevents passive play, **blocking** an attack will take your **posture** instead of your HP (not including chip damage). A non displayed meter, if **depleted** will not allow the user to block the next attack. Getting hit with depleted posture will trigger a “**Guard break**” which stuns the defender giving the opponent an opening to attack.
- **Stamina:**
  To prevent infinite running just like posture it is an non displayed meter, when **depleted** will not allow the user to sprint.
  **Posture is NOT needed to perfect block (parry)**

---

**Combat style perks that affect posture:**

`Crushing Force I` : +10% posture damage on every hit. ([Kickboxing](https://trello.com/c/wTEq8I8q/218-kickboxing "‌"))

‌

- Swift Recovery: +15% posture regen. ([Basic](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq "‌"))

‌

- Steady Nerves: +25% posture regen for 3s after a parry ([Karate](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG "‌"))

‌

- Balanced Strike: Landing an M2 refunds 25% of your max posture. ([Karate](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG "‌"))

**Attack Buffs:**

- Disorientating: M2s halt victims posture regen for 3s. ([Muay Thai](https://trello.com/c/9KpdQtMi "‌"))

cards.desc:
Every combat style has a ‘Block Chip Percentage’ via the `Guard Pierce` perk.

- This controls how much damage your attack does on somebody that blocked the attack.
- There is **NO DAMAGE** done if the attack is parried.

For example, if my style has `Guard Pierce I: 10% block chip damage`, a blocked attack that normally does `5 DMG` will only do `0.5 DMG`. However, If I had a style with `Guard Pierce IV: 25% block chip damage`, then it would do `1.25 DMG` instead.

`Guard Pierce`:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a508f06416ab8fcc9508bd9/attachments/6ae8978234d833970115a6cc/previews/6ae8978234d833970115a7b5/download/image.webp)

cards.desc:
_Parrying_ is a timed block right as an attack is about to land. If your timing is inside the **parry window** while facing the attacker, you **perfect block** instead of taking a normal block.

- A parry is **not** a normal block: **no damage, no block chip, no posture loss.**
- **Parrying** _stuns_ your attacker temporarily for **0.45 seconds**, presenting the opportunity to counter and attack them.

**Combat Style Perks** that reward parrying:

- Counterstrike: +5% damage on your next attack after a parry. ([Basic](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq "‌"), [Ali](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali "‌"), [Kyokushin Karate](https://trello.com/c/Furm0NSZ "‌"))
- Perfect Reflex: If M2 on cooldown, parrying reduces remaining cooldown by 1s. ([Boxing](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC "‌"))

This is when your block is broken. You take full guard break damage, and get stunned for ~2 seconds.

- **You do not take block chip damage on guardbreaks**
- `M2s` **always** break your block, so you must either parry, dodge, or hit them before theirs lands.
- `M1s` can break your block if you run out of enough posture to do so (`<10`)

## **COMMON PERKS**

‌

- **Heavy Hitter**: Deals extra damage when hitting an opponent whose defense was just completely broken.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae898bb30691f30ec8e60b2/previews/6ae898bb30691f30ec8e6148/download/image.webp)

- **Guard Pierce**: Allows a certain percentage of your damage to sneak through the enemy's block and hurt their health directly.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-02\_160029.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae89876b740ed3211560119/previews/6ae89877b740ed321156012e/download/Screenshot_2026-11-02_160029.webp)

- **Resilience**: Gives a chance to trigger an automatic wrestling grab when your light attack hits the enemy's light attack at the exact same time.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae898da08615a8296e2f0cd/previews/6ae898db08615a8296e2f141/download/image.webp)

- **Powerful**: Your heavy attacks completely flatten opponents on impact, throwing them into the air where they cannot control their character.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae8992d99908451458f3238/previews/6ae8992e99908451458f3279/download/image.webp)

- **Crushing Force**: Every single hit deals extra damage to the opponent's blocking meter, making it much easier to break their shield.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae899783667d6b2b78564af/previews/6ae899783667d6b2b7856514/download/image.webp)

- **Counterstrike**: Gives a temporary damage boost to your very next attack right after you execute a perfectly timed block.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae89ab90be38dcf863fde16/previews/6ae89ab90be38dcf863fdec2/download/image.webp)

- **Takedown**: Changes your heavy attack into a wrestling grab or ground slam that deals a massive multiplier of damage.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae89a5226bf85f5761dcdde/previews/6ae89a5326bf85f5761dce55/download/image.webp)

- **Hyperarmor M2s**: Protects you from being stunned or interrupted while swinging a heavy attack, meaning the enemy cannot stop your punch even if they hit you first.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae89a3c8a2cb203a60d6075/previews/6ae89a3c8a2cb203a60d60de/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aa074138d04a86ced3c7d20/attachments/6ae899b7ccd34ef572f5b681/previews/6ae899b7ccd34ef572f5b730/download/image.webp)

## **UNIQUE STYLE PERKS**

### **Mishima**

- **Consistency**: Landing 4 basic light attacks on the same target without missing cripples their legs, cutting their movement speed in half.

> _Stats:_ `4 seconds`

- **Shifty**: Successfully dodging a basic light attack with your dash instantly resets your dash timer so you can dodge again right away.

### **Ali**

- **Float Like a Butterfly**: Your critical dodge shuffle makes you completely invincible during the movement, letting you slide clean through enemy attacks without taking damage.
- **Sting Like a Bee**: Whenever you successfully dodge an attack, your character automatically and instantly lunges forward with a counter-attack straight at the enemy.

### **Basic**

- **Swift Recovery**: Increases the speed at which your character naturally recovers their blocking shield meter.

> _Stats:_ Tier I (`+15% recovery speed`)

### **Boxing**

- **Untouchable**: Your heavy attack fires a fast two-punch combo with moments of complete invincibility, letting you safely absorb the first enemy hit and block the second one.

### **Capoeira**

- **Ginga**: Shortens the waiting timer before you can use your dodge dash again.

> _Stats:_ `-25% waiting time`

### **CQC**

- **Killing Intent**: Marks the closest enemy and forces your character to dash forward with five unstoppable strikes. (Can only be stopped if you are hit in the first 0.5 seconds).
- **Upper Hand**: Winning a wrestling grab grants a 5-second buff where every hit you land increases your damage step-by-step.

> _Stats:_ `+5% damage per hit` (Maximum stack up to `+25%`)

- **Boss Raid**: Gives a permanent total damage boost for every unique enemy player that hits you.

> _Stats:_ `+2% damage per unique player` (Maximum stack up to `+10%` per life)

### **Hakari**

- **Momentum Rush**: Landing 3 basic light attacks in a row without getting interrupted unlocks a fury window where your heavy attack deals massive multi-hit damage.

> _Stats:_ `7 seconds duration` | `3x damage output`

### **Karate**

- **Steady Nerves**: Executing a perfectly timed block gives you a temporary boost to your shield recovery speed.

> _Stats:_ `+15% recovery speed` for `3 seconds`

- **Balanced Strike**: Landing a heavy attack instantly gives you back a chunk of the shield energy you spent to use the move.

> _Stats:_ `25% energy back`

### **Kickboxing**

- **Low Guard**: Landing both hits of your kick attack increases the enemy's dodge dash cooldown timer massively for a brief time.

> _Stats:_ `+40% waiting time` for `5 seconds`

### **Kure**

- **Last Stand**: When your health drops below a specific threshold, your character enters a rage that increases all your damage output.

> _Stats:_ Activates below `25% HP` | `+15% total damage`

### **Kyokushin**

- **Obsidian Skeleton**: Hardens your body to permanently reduce all incoming damage that you take from any enemy attack.

> _Stats:_ `-10% damage taken`

### **Slugger**

- **Unstable**: Turns your character into a glass cannon, increasing the damage you deal but making you take more damage when enemies hit you.

> _Stats:_ `+40% damage dealt` | `+15% damage taken`

### **Striker**

- **Broken Rhythm**: Every punch in your combo chain swings faster than the last one, making your attack speed completely unpredictable and hard to block.

> _Stats:_ From `0.35s` speed down to `0.12s` speed

- **Feint**: Turns your critical move into a trick attack that fakes a kick to bait the enemy, then lands the real hit a split second later while letting you block safely.

> _Stats:_ Fake setup at `0.15s` | Real hit at `0.40s`

### **Wing Chun**

- **Sticky Hands**: Replaces your regular heavy attack with a defensive guard that catches incoming enemy strikes, cancels them out, and automatically counters with a combo.
- **Swift Hands**: Permanently increases the swing speed of your basic light attacks at the cost of losing a tiny bit of raw damage per punch.

> _Stats:_ `+8% faster speed` | `-0.2 damage per hit`

- **Final Blow**: Adds a powerful finisher effect to your basic attack chain, causing the very last punch of your combo to deal increased damage.

> _Stats:_ `1.5x more damage`

- **Fortified**: Increases your blocking defenses, causing you to lose less shield meter when you block enemy hits.

> _Stats:_ Tier I (`-10% shield loss while blocking`)

cards.desc:
**Hyper-Armor** is when your attack absorbs a hit without flinching. You still take full damage, but your swing cannot be interrupted and plays out to completion.

- **Hyper-Armor does not stop damage.** You eat the hit, but you keep swinging.
- `M2s` are the only armored attacks currently, active from startup until the hit lands.
- **Hyper-Armor** is limited to certain styles.

**The combat style perks that include hyper-armor:**

- ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5105dbc5e9daa0207fc730/attachments/6ae89811dbcd250f355b59d1/previews/6ae89811dbcd250f355b59e8/download/image.webp)

---

**IFrames** are a brief window where your character is completely unhittable. Attacks pass through you dealing no damage, no chip, and no hitstun the hit simply whiffs.

- **Nothing connects during i-frames.** Unlike hyper armor, you take zero damage, not full damage.
- `Dodges` are the main i-frame moves, active only during the animation's startup and travel you are vulnerable again on recovery.
- I-frames avoid strikes, but **do not** save you from `clashing`.
- Getting hit on recovery (after the window ends) is a full punish, a whiffed dodge is worse than blocking.
- You are an additional **iframe dodge** when fighting more than 1 opponent.

**Combat style perks which include Iframes:**

- **Untouchable**
  M2ing throws a two-punch combo with **IFrames** for the whole animation. Each punch is its own attack. You can eat the first and parry the second. ([Boxing](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC "‌"))
- Float Like a Butterfly
  The crit shuffle grants **IFrames** for its entire windup, Shuffle straight through anything thrown at you. ([Ali](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali "‌"))

## GENERAL RULES

‌

- **15 Awakenable Styles:** Jin, Boxing, Karate, Taijutsu, Lethwei, Hakari, Wrestling, Aikido, Kure, Kickboxing, Cqc, Slugger, kyokushin and Striker.
- **3 Stages:** Complete Stage 3 to master the style and automatically activate it’s V2.
- **V2 Toggle:** Switch V2 on or off through the Awakening Panel. This cannot be done while in combat or downed.
- **Style-Specific Progress:** Only progress for your currently equipped fighting style counts.
- **Saved Progress:** Progress is saved separately for each style. Switching styles does not erase saved progress.
- **Progress Tracking:** Only Stage 1 displays a progress bar. Stages 2 and 3 have no counter; use your character's inner thoughts for hints.
- **Stage 3 Trials:** These are one-time trials. Leaving, switching styles, failing, or no longer meeting the required conditions resets the trial to 0.
  - **Exception:** Karate Stage 3 progress is saved.

---

## TAIMANS & CALLOUTS

#### **Spawning**

- Taimans spawn every 8–15 minutes server-wide, following the order players joined the server.
- A Taiman spawns approximately 10 studs behind you and follows you.
- Taimans can spawn anywhere near your character, except in safezones.

#### **Fight**

- Once the Taiman reaches you, it will lean its hands back and say "taiman, one on one".
- Punch the Taiman to start the fight.
- After knocking them out, grip them if possible to ensure the win counts.

#### **Important Details**

- **Quest Requirement:** Only Taimans that spawn for you count. Stealing another player's Taiman will not count.
- **Private Servers:** Taimans do not spawn in private servers.

> **Tip:** Use a small or empty public server to reduce waiting time.

---

## FAIR FIGHT RULES & LIMITS

#### **Valid Targets**

- **Players:** Must hit you first or hit you back.
- **NPCs:** Street Crew members or NPCs actively fighting you.
- Randomly attacking players or NPCs who aren't fighting back does not count as a fair fight.

#### **Hourly Limits Against the Same Player**

- 150 Hits
- 40 Perfect Blocks
- 25 Guardbreaks
- 25 Critical Hits (M2)
- 20 Clash Wins
- 3 Knockouts

> These limits do not apply to NPCs or punching bags.

‌

- **Knockout Credit:** You must have landed the last hit within 10 seconds before the opponent goes down.
- **Punching Bags:** A maximum of approximately 4-5 hits per second are counted.
- **Nighttime:** In-game time between 07:00 PM and 06:00 AM.

## Recommended Build:

For the **Ali**, a **short** build _(around 4'11-5'3)_ is recommended to maintain constant pressure on your opponent while simultaneously evading counter attacks. The shorter cooldowns and faster movement from a shorter height allows the user to maximize their offensive capabilities while still keeping a high defense up with their heavy and evasive.

Ali excels when keeping constant pressure on their opponent, making usage of the **+5% damage buff** from **Counterstrike** on their next attack after a successful parry. Ali is able to move in quickly and land their critical attack with their I-Frames from **Float Like a Butterfly** and make use of **Sting Like a Bee** to dodge an opponents attack with their evasive to allow their own attack. **Guard Pierce III** also grants **20% block chip damage** and **Resilience II** grants a **25% chance to clash into a grapple when attacks meet.**

Short builds are ideal for maintaining constant pressure and swiftness, but **tall** builds could still be a viable option with their extended reach and ability to keep pressure. **Medium** builds are not recommended for **Ali.**

**Recommended Build:**
For the **Kure**, a **medium to tall height** _(around **5'9" / 175 cm** or taller)_ is recommended to maximize your reach and make it easier to apply constant pressure. The added range helps you land M2s more consistently and capitalize on openings during close range combat.

Kure excels in extended fights with its powerful passives. **Last Stand** grants **+15% damage** when below **25% health**, while **Takedown** upgrades your M2 headbutt into a grab that disorients the opponent and deals **1.5× damage**. **Concussive** prevents opponents from parrying for **2 seconds** after a successful M2 slam, giving you a strong opportunity to continue your offense. **Guard Pierce II** also deals **15% chip damage** through blocks, and **Resilience I** provides a **15% chance** to clash into a grapple.

While **medium and tall builds** are ideal for maximizing pressure and reach, **shorter builds are still a viable option** for players who prefer increased mobility. Kure is best suited for aggressive players who enjoy staying on the offensive and overwhelming their opponents.

Players have a 95% chance to roll Japanese. Other ethnicities are a 5% chance to roll with each being 1%.

Ethnicity affects: Hair Type, Surnames, Natural Hair-color pool, Average Height, and Skintone.

**Obtainable ethnicities are the following:**

- **Japanese - 95%**
- **European - 1%**
- **Indian - 1 %**
- **MiddleEastern - 1%**
- **African - 1%**
- **Latino/Latina - 1%**

Skintones are randomly selected given your ethnicity (click the image for higher quality):

cards.desc:
Character height slightly affects game play and is randomly generated based on your character's gender and ethnicity.

**Taller characters**

- More health and damage
- Larger hit boxes
- Slower movement and attacks
- Shorter Dashes

**Shorter characters**

- Less health and damage
- Smaller hit boxes
- Faster movement, attacks, and cool downs
- Longer Dashes

Your height does effect your HP.  Shorter heights have less health while taller heights have more.

### Male Averages

- European — 178 cm (5'10")
- African — 175 cm (5'9")
- Middle Eastern — 173 cm (5'8")
- Japanese — 171 cm (5'7")
- Latino — 170 cm (5'7")
- Indian — 167 cm (5'6")

### Female Averages

- European — 165 cm (5'5")
- African — 162 cm (5'4")
- Middle Eastern — 160 cm (5'3")
- Japanese — 159 cm (5'3")
- Latina — 158 cm (5'2")
- Indian — 155 cm (5'1")

Heights closer to the average are more common, while very short and very tall characters are much rarer.

**Hair Color**

A character's hair color is determined by their ethnicity, which links them to a specific table of natural RGB color values, when a character is generated, there is a 95% chance they will receive a natural hair color fitting their demographic—such as Japanese primarily pulling black hair, and European drawing from a wider range like brown, blonde, or auburn. The remaining 5% of the time, a "hair dye" event triggers, generating a random RGB color from the wheel.

# Sport Traits

Each sport (Basketball, Volleyball, Soccer) features two active trait slots to modify your playstyle.

- **Primary Slot:** Operates at 100% full strength.
- **Sub Slot:** Operates at 75% strength.
- **Swapping:** Switch traits between the two slots at any time.
- **Rerolls:** Costs ¥250 or 1 Ticket.

> A reroll will never land on the trait active in your other slot.

animals can be found around the map, with each having unique interactions and small chances of doing something

## Dogs

- **You can pet dogs** They will Follow you around temporarily once you pet them
- **Dogs interaction with crows** Crows that mess with dogs, surrounding the dog and bothering it
- **Dogs interaction with crows 2** Crows can ride the dogs
- **Dogs interaction with cats** The dogs can BARK at cats when too close, they can chase one another shortly.
- **Dogs interaction to attacks** The dogs will BITE you. 5 bites per dog, If another dog is nearby they can team up on you.
- **dogs can be seen with different variants**
- **Dog idle** They stretch, lick themselves, sit, etc.

## Cats

- **Initial approach** Running towards a cat too close will make it hiss at you or make it back up.
- **You can pet cats** Nothing happens when you pet them, but petting them TOO much will make them bite you once.
- **Cats interaction with dogs** If a dog is following you, cats will run away after hissing at you.
- **Cats will Follow you** Cats can follow you, but its a lower chance than dogs, cats will follow you longer than dogs once they start to.
- **Cats interaction with crows**
- **Cats Variety** 6 cat varieties
- **Idle stance** Stretching, cleaning themselves, sleep, etc.

## Crows

- Crows will "respect" you if you die.
- You can FEED the crows, it will say you're on their good side.
- Crows will gather on top of you if you are idle long enough.

## How to tame a crow:

if you want to have a crow on your side that follows you around, you need to buy any type of food in Gakumart, drop it somewhere without people and sit with any emote. You’ll have to do it at least 1-3 times and you’ll notice that a crow will come at you and will begin to follow.  The crow can “peck” someone while you fighting (doesn’t deal dmg) and they’ll stay with you until you leave the server.

# Phones

## Opening Your Phone:

To open your phone, press Alt/D-Pad Down, which will greet you with this UI:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a66a9defaa4c76b07d0b643/previews/6a66a9dffaa4c76b07d0bfb7/download/image.webp)

To progress past this screen, press the “OK” button, which will open a menu that features all of the apps:

Once you are here, you can use the arrow keys on the phone to navigate or alternatively click on the apps.

# Apps:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb8346aef5eaf64d7e1b7/previews/6a7cb8356aef5eaf64d7e3a7/download/image.webp)

## **My Phone:**

the My Phone app displays the following information about you:

- Phone Number
- Yen
- Total Contacts
- Messages Sent
- Total Messages Received
- Phone Model
- Calls
- Call Time
- And Carrier
- Weather
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726c20472399ec1003a0c9/previews/6a726c21472399ec1003a1f1/download/image.webp)

## **Dial:**

Dial allows you to dial players phone numbers. Furthermore, by dialing peoples phone numbers you can save them as a contact.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726c77335a2c5faa1bf4ce/previews/6a726c77335a2c5faa1bf6ce/download/image.webp)

## **Calls:**

Calls shows all past calls (which also allows you to save contacts after a call)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb881275df5c4e7493ff3/previews/6a7cb883275df5c4e749417b/download/image.webp)

## **Contacts:**

Contacts shows a list of all saved contacts

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726ca69a246e8612cd6197/previews/6a726ca69a246e8612cd62e3/download/image.webp)

## **Games:**

The Games app opens a menu that lets you select various phone games to play.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726cb7d05cb4df2f129d3d/previews/6a726cb8d05cb4df2f129e95/download/image.webp)

## **Social Link:**

Social link allows two players to connect phone numbers without the trouble of dialing them. To use it, both players must open social link in proximity to each other. After locating the person you want, click “OK” and save their contact.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e790b1c7ad14f7d4c4e6f/previews/6a6e790b1c7ad14f7d4c4f62/download/image.webp)

## **Mixi:**

Mixi is an in game global social media app, that allows you to create posts, and like/comment other people’s posts. To create a post, click the left pad next to the arrow keys.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e7959262cc8c5b54cdd10/previews/6a6e795b262cc8c5b54cde11/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e7ac7f1f6a3cfa75cf90e/previews/6a6e7ac8f1f6a3cfa75cfb47/download/image.webp)

## **Camera:**

The Camera app allows players to take photos using their in game phone.

To use it:

1. Open your phone.
2. Select **Camera**.
3. Switch between 3 different custom filters for different vibes.
4. Switch between **front** and **back** camera.
5. Take a photo.

- **Back Camera** – Captures the world, environments, and other players.
- **Front Camera** – Takes selfies of your character.
  ![Screenshot\_2026-07-11\_131704.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a52da71070234ae653b984e/previews/6a52da71070234ae653b9912/download/Screenshot_2026-07-11_131704.webp)

Photos can be taken instantly anywhere in the world.

**Saving Photos (Roblox Captures)**

After taking a photo, players can save it to Roblox:

1. Open the photo preview.
2. Select **Save to Captures**.

The image is stored in your **Roblox Captures** and can be accessed outside the game through your Roblox account.

## **Japanify:**

is your built in music collection, allowing players to browse and listen to music with ease. You can view your **liked songs**, explore **playlists**, listen to music from your favorite **artists**, and search for **recently added songs**, all from one convenient interface. It's designed to make discovering and organizing music simple while enhancing your in game experience.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a726cd641f9ad89c1bb1af2/previews/6a726cd741f9ad89c1bb1c56/download/image.webp)

## **YenApp:**

**Tags:** Choosing a tag is essentially your username on the app, it is what players type in when they want to send you money. After choosing a tag you will be greeted with this screen:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a6e77a6534d0dbd2ce096a8/previews/6a6e77a6534d0dbd2ce09792/download/image.webp)

The Activity button will show all transactions. You can search other players tags by clicking the black bar and typing in their name.

## **Indeed App**:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a701ba6b8ca6b95cde9b3c7/previews/6a701ba7b8ca6b95cde9b59e/download/image.webp)

Is a simple application that allows players to apply for shifts at different Job locations for Yen!

## **Weather App**:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51685360ceb81ccca74272/attachments/6a7cb8564f30af29efe497c3/previews/6a7cb8564f30af29efe4993f/download/image.webp)

A simple application that displays the current weather in the server.

There are 5 clubs you can choose from, join one at its board in the club room. The 5 clubs include Biology Club, Calligraphy Club, Astronomy Club, Gardening Club, and Light Music Club.

Club uniforms can be accessed at any time from their respective club boards after reaching 1,000 points in that club.

‌

**Biology Club**

The Biology club is found on the first floor to the left of the entrance and beside the locker area. Upon joining the biology club, your task for getting points is finding specimen via the microscope. You unlock more specimens to find as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac18155422926300b517a94/previews/6ac18156422926300b517ae0/download/image.webp)

**Calligraphy Club**

The Calligraphy club is found on the first floor right infront of the biology room and beside the stairs on the left. Upon joining the calligraphy club, your task for getting points is writing calligraphy. The calligraphy that you have to write is random. You unlock more kanji to write as you level your rank up by doing tasks for points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ac16af62e95d1ead1847023/attachments/6ac1892468629eac5381ba97/previews/6ac1892568629eac5381bb6f/download/image.webp)

**Gardening Club**

The Gardening club is found on the right wing of the Gakuran building on the roof. Upon joining the gardening club, your task for getting points is taking care of them by giving the water they need, making sure they get enough sunlight, and removing bugs if there are any.

The maximum amount plants that you can take care of in one bed is three plants and you unlock more seeds to plant as you level up. It is recommended to do this club activity when the sun is up so you won't have to worry about the sunlight part of the activity, making it easier for you to complete it. You can abandon the responsibility of taking care of the plants by giving up your bed using the button on the upper right corner.

The Astronomy Club is found on the third floor of the school, upon joining the astronomy club you go to any available telescope and interact with it, when interacting with it you the get given a starry image in the bottom left, that you need to connect the dots (stars) with, upon completion you earn points that work towards your club, astrology also unlocks planets that show in the sky.

## NPC Events

> Automobiles (of various colors and models) can be found driven by NPCs on the roads outside of Nishikata High—this includes: smaller two-door cars, four-door cars, small trucks, small vans, semi-trucks, and taxis.

Running into vehicles moving at a substantial speed will cause you to take damage, knockback, and you'll be ragdolled for a couple of seconds.

Whilst riding a skateboard, moving in close proximity to the rear end of a vehicle (with the exception of semi-trucks) will force your character to grab onto one of the rear corners of the vehicle, allowing you to hitch a ride by hanging on. You can stop this action at any time by simply tapping "s" (backward movement key).

You are able to attack vehicles with your fists—they aren't destructible, but the NPC inside the vehicle will show dialogue in complaint to your actions.
In some cases, continuing to attack the vehicle will result in the NPC exiting the vehicle and aggroing you.
If enough damage to the NPC is dealt, they will re-enter the vehicle and flee the scene.

Student council waits outside of the gate with 1 teacher, 3 student councils and greet you / tell you to hurry to class

The game features a variety of playable instruments that use a rhythm-based gameplay system similar to popular music games. There are two **music rooms** located on the third floor of the school. Instead of simply activating an instrument, players must hit incoming notes with proper timing to perform songs successfully.

Notes travel down designated lanes toward target circles. As each note reaches its target, players press the corresponding key at the correct moment — the accuracy of the input determines the quality of the hit.

**Click** [**here**](https://trello.com/c/wQkJJHPV "‌") **to view a list of all playable songs by instrument**

**Note Ratings**

- **Perfect** — exceptional timing and accuracy.
- **Good** — slightly off but still accurate.
- **Okay** — acceptable timing with noticeable error.
- **Bad** — poor timing or a near miss, leads to the respective missed note sound being played.
- **Miss** - complete miss of the note, leads to the respective missed note sound being played.

Percentage accuracy is based on the amount of Perfect, Good, and Okay notes, divided by the total amount of notes in the song.

![instrument.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a7292e7687caa386a4f9817/download/instrument.gif)

**100 Note Combo Vfx**:

![out.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6aa5d33c54fef7fd472bac8d/previews/6aa5d35254fef7fd472bc9e2/download/out.gif)

---

**Calibration**

- You can calibrate your timing to what feels right for you.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a77aa67b72bec1ec92bdda9/previews/6a77aa68b72bec1ec92bde58/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a77aa6e849e167d7f038048/previews/6a77aa6f849e167d7f038103/download/image.webp)

---

**Available Instruments**

**Electric Guitar**

- Uses two note lanes.
- Played with the `F` and `J` keys. (Keys are rebind-able in settings)
- Designed for a simpler but fast-paced rhythm experience.

**Bass Guitar**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Hit notes across four separate paths using the assigned keys.

**Drums**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Accurately match incoming drum notes across all four lanes to maintain rhythm.

**Keyboard**

- Uses four note lanes.
- Focuses on timing and accuracy across multiple paths to simulate playing a song on a keyboard.

**Piano**

- Uses Roblox Virtual Piano letter-based keyboard notes.
- Only instrument not based on a **rhythm-based gameplay system**
- Press SPACE to bring up the sheet music list.

‌

Each instrument has its own feel while following the same core mechanics. Success depends on **timing, rhythm, and accuracy**  not character stats.

---

**Multiplayer Performance**
Instruments fully support synchronized group performances. When a player starts a song, others can join at any time and are automatically placed at the exact same point in the song.

- Multiple players can perform together simultaneously.
- Players who join late are auto-synced to the current section of the song.
- Everyone plays the same song at the same time.
- Performances stay synchronized for all participating musicians.

For example, one player can perform on electric guitar while others join on bass, drums, or piano each synced to the same song progression, creating the feeling of playing together as a **live band**.

---

**Customization**

Within settings you are able to customize various properties of the rhythm portion of the instruments.

Such as Color:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a516a15e67f6f3f525a28c5/attachments/6a726b1abba91dbbf761e295/previews/6a726b1abba91dbbf761e2c2/download/image.webp)

cards.desc:
**Glasses**

Glasses are face accessories that you can roll for through the game's accessory system. they let you customize your avatar's appearance and come in 2 distinct styles. 

• **Thick Black Glasses**- a more larger, bolder look that stands out on your face.

• **Thin Black Glasses**-a sleeker, more subtle style for a cleaner look. 

Aside from looking clean and nice, wearing glasses introduces a unique mechanic during combat. 

**What Occurs During Combat With Glasses**
If you take a heavy enough punch to the face, your glasses can get knocked completely off and drop to the ground. 

**What happens your glasses fly off:**

 • They are instantly unequipped 

 • Your screen becomes blurred, impairing your vision.

 • This blur effect stays on your screen until you get your glasses back.

**How to restore your normal vision**

• Locate where your glasses fell

• pick them up and equip them 

Once re-equipped, the blur effect clears up immediately.

---

**Headphones**

Headphones are an in-game accessory that allow you to play music from your phone to your headphones (without your phone having to be out).

‌

- There is currently no way to remove headphones off of your head by yourself, you must have another player hit them off of you.
- You can re-equip your headphones by using the interact button to pick them up off the floor and then clicking again to equip them.
- When your headphones get knocked off your head, music will continue to play through them, unless intentionally stopped via phone.

‌

To see all variants of headphones, look at your gender specific accessory list.

---

**Eyepatches**

The eyepatch is a head accessory within Gakuran featuring multiple variants. When wearing an eyepatch, vision is partially blocked in first person.

cards.desc:
**Chess:**

Chess is a classical game of skill played between two players tfound in the Board Game room.

- 2 players are required to play chess
- There are NPC’s found in the chess room with varying skill to play against

Note that: Chess pieces can still be moved without another player in the seat, meaning you don’t need another person to activate the game.

---

**Connect Four**

A classic two-player game located in the Chess Clubroom. Players take turns dropping colored discs into a vertical grid, and the first to line up four of their discs in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally — wins. A quick, easy way to challenge friends between activities.

---

**Karaoke**

Step into a lively karaoke bar where music, laughter, and good times come together. Guest can choose their favorite songs, sing on stage with friends or they can cheer you on! With colorful lights, energetic music, refreshing drinks from the vending machine outside. It's the perfect place to relax after having a dinner at _Dante's Yakiniku Restaurant_ or after the school day. _**To play a song**_, interact with either the Television or I-pad on the table (songs cost 100¥ to play).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6a80d300dc41240ba6bdfdd9/previews/6a80d302dc41240ba6be01d9/download/image.webp)

---

**Arm Wrestling** A quick fun game of arm wrestling located on-top the roof or in the cafe, consisting of quick time events between two players, timing your inputs to best the other player. **How do scores work?** Different Scores: _Miss/Ok/Good/Perfect_

- The **CLOSER** you and your opponents scores are, the **LESS** the one with less is pushed back.
- The **FARTHER** you and your opponents scores are, the **MORE** the one with less is pushed back

![armwrestling.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6a79d824fd17219bccd0108a/previews/6a79d82ffd17219bccd022a4/download/armwrestling.gif)

---

## Arcade Room:

**PAC-MAN**
The player guides a bright yellow circular character with a wide mouth through a closed maze. The goal is to eat all small dots while avoiding four colorful ghosts. Eating flashing "**Power Pellets**" lets Pac-Man temporarily eat the ghosts. Eating fruits awards bonus points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a21c8040294aeefc76b6/previews/6a77a21e8040294aeefc76d4/download/image.webp)

**ARCADE INVADERS**
A classic fixed shooter where you control a laser cannon at the bottom of the screen. Your goal is to defeat rows of descending aliens by shooting them before they reach the bottom of the screen.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a242a4d9406001e2ed62/previews/6a77a243a4d9406001e2ed90/download/image.webp)

**AIR HOCKEY**
Your goal is to guide to score into the opponents goal and come out victorious. First to three wins The player controls the air hockey striker with their mouse; guide the puck into the other teams goal to win a point.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a2b6cc23cec9131f4bb1/previews/6a77a2b7cc23cec9131f4bef/download/image.webp)

**ASTRO CROSSER**

The core objective is to shoot and destroy drifting large rocks and occasional flying saucers while managing ship momentum and avoiding crashes.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a77a07422a0c317ea55fc71/attachments/6a77a307f09ad4cae88bd42e/previews/6a77a308f09ad4cae88bd503/download/image.webp)

---

**Coin Flip Gesture**

A quick flip of the coin which determines either heads or tails.

![dldld.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6ac179cfab13fc381b0a28b0/previews/6ac179d7ab13fc381b0a3a94/download/dldld.gif)

---

**Dice Roll Gesture**

A quick dice roll that lands on a number one through six.

![dice\_roll.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6ac17a4c1dbc61f5c0be5303/previews/6ac17a531dbc61f5c0be5813/download/dice_roll.gif)

---

**Rock Paper Scissors**

A duo emote that plays the classic game of Rock Paper Scissors. You and your opponent can choose between the 3 options of Rock, Paper, & Scissors.

![ock\_paper.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a79d79f6f8a75044b51e468/attachments/6ac17acca2e9fed61213d1e1/previews/6ac17ad5a2e9fed61213e416/download/ock_paper.gif)

cards.desc:
## NPCs:

Each NPC has a different personality which means that each of them can speak differently. They're able to read their stats such as grade, age, height and ethnicity which all alter how they will/can answer. NPCs are also able to read your own stats and mention them in a conversation.

---

## Commands:

You can use commands such as /s to shout or whisper and they'll whisper/shout back at you (not always). Some NPCs do not like shouting or will find it weird to shout.

---

## Memory:

NPCs can remember you. If you tell an NPC their name, they'll remember it and when you go away and come back to ask them "do you know me" they'll mention your name and say how you were here a second ago.

---

## Time:

NPC interactions also depend on time. When it's morning and a class is starting, they'll tell you how it's time to go to class
they're able to mention the time and which class you need be in, if you ask them which class to go some will say the exact time of how long it'll last

---

## Locations:

NPCs know their location, depending on where they stand, they'll mention it if you ask them and also what class you must be

**Gardening Club**

The Gardening club is found on the right wing of the Gakuran building on the roof. Upon joining the gardening club, your task for getting points is taking care of them by giving the water they need, making sure they get enough sunlight, and removing bugs if there are any.

The maximum amount plants that you can take care of in one bed is three plants and you unlock more seeds to plant as you level up. It is recommended to do this club activity when the sun is up so you won't have to worry about the sunlight part of the activity, making it easier for you to complete it. You can abandon the responsibility of taking care of the plants by giving up your bed using the button on the upper right corner.

# **Basketball:**

is a skill-based activity focused on **timing, ball control, positioning, and defensive pressure**. Basketballs can be found on the racks near the hoop.

**Shooting:**

- Hold `E` to begin your shooting motion - a shot meter starts filling
- Release `E` to shoot
- The timing of your release determines the quality of the shot.
- Press Shift + Spacebar to perform a Dunk near the rim
- Shift + Tapping `E` to perform a Euro Step Dunk
- Press `G` to post up, `G+E` allows you to do a Post Fadeaway

## Power Meter Settings

**Shot Meter Zones**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6ac16b60b79679d36c1f2576/previews/6ac16b61b79679d36c1f2653/download/image.webp)

**Three-Point Scoring**
On both the Courtyard and Indoor Basketball courts, there are large semi-circles(the yellow line indoors and one of the white lines in the courtyard) that form a perimeter around the hoops on each side of the court.

These semi-circles are your **Three-Point Lines**.

They represent the perimeter by which any shot made past them(closer to the half-court line) will count for 3 points, however any shots made closer to the goal will instead only court for 2 points.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211c34/previews/6a8a0b80e7a2545389211cde/download/image.webp)

---

**Defensive Pressure:**
Shot timing isn't the only factor. An active defender's positioning and pressure can reduce the shooter's chance of making the basket.

- Open shots are easier to make.
- Lightly contested shots are more difficult.
- Heavily contested shots are significantly harder to score.
- Strong pressure can lower shooting effectiveness even on otherwise decent releases.

Creating space before shooting is often just as important as timing the shot itself.

**Ball Handling:**
Several dribble moves let you create separation and outmaneuver defenders.

- `X` — Bounce-Back Dribble
- `Z + X` — Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `C + X` — Alternate Behind-the-Back Dribble
- `Backspace` — Drop the Ball
- Ball in right hand, `C+C`  — Right Spin Move
- Ball in left hand, `Z+Z`— Left Spin Move
- `Z or X` — Swap ball to other hand.
- Client Sided Numbers are assigned to teammates, pressing a corresponding number allows you to pass to the teammate

![basketballskill.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5168d0424edbc0debeeeb7/attachments/6a8d31bb2586ae699c082482/previews/6a8d31cd2586ae699c082df3/download/basketballskill.gif)

Combining dribble moves helps break through defenses and create open shooting opportunities.

**Defense:**
Defense plays a major role in stopping opponents from scoring.

- `RMB` (Right Mouse Button) — Defensive Stance
- `F` — Screen (Off-Ball)
- `R`— Steal (Off-Ball)
- `Space` — Block (Off-Ball)

Holding `RMB` puts your character in a defensive stance, letting you guard the ball handler, contest shots, cut off driving lanes, and apply pressure. The closer and more effectively you defend, the harder their shot becomes.
